title: Two Paths: One's Legit, One's a Dead End
paragraphs: Man, you're blessed. You don't just go with the flow and do what everyone else is doing, you don't hang out with the wrong crowd, and you don't waste your time with people who think they know it all.
Instead, you're all about what God has to say. You're thinking about His word day and night. You're like a tree that's been planted in the perfect spot, always producing good fruit, always thriving.
The wicked are nothing like that. They're like dust in the wind, totally unstable. They won't have a leg to stand on when it's time for judgment, and they don't fit in with the righteous.
God's got His eye on the path you're on, but the path of the wicked? That leads to a dead end.

title: God Laughs at Haters & Crowns His King
paragraphs: Yo, what's with all the drama, nations? Why are you all plotting shady stuff? World leaders are scrambling for power, politicians are having secret meetings, and all the people who hate God and the Messiah are like, 'Let's ditch God! We don't need a Messiah!'

God, chilling on his throne in heaven, just starts laughing. At first, he thinks it's kinda funny how bold they are, but then he gets seriously mad. He shuts them down real quick, like, 'Uh, have you forgotten who's in charge? There's a King in Zion, and we're throwing a huge party for his coronation on the holy mountain.'

So then God says to me, 'You're my son, and today's your birthday. Seriously, what do you want? I'll give you whole nations as a gift, entire continents as a prize. You can make them do whatever you want, or just toss them out like old news.'

So, all you rebel kings and wannabe judges, get a clue. Worship God with everything you've got, celebrate him with some serious respect. Show love to the Messiah! Your lives are on the line, for real. His anger is about to blow up, but if you run to God for safety, you won't regret it..

title: Haters Everywhere, But God's Got My Back
paragraphs: God, for real, look at this! I've got haters coming at me from all sides. They're popping up everywhere like mushrooms, and the whole mob is just laughing at me, saying, 'LOL, God's not gonna help him now.'
But you, God, you're my shield, protecting me from everything. You keep me grounded and help me stand tall. When I yell out to you, you answer back like thunder from your holy mountain.
I can just lie down and sleep, and then I wake up totally refreshed and ready to go. I'm not even scared of all these enemy mobs coming at me from every direction.
Get up, God! My God, help me! Shut them down. Slap them in the face, first one cheek, then the other. Punch them right in the teeth!
Because real help, the only help that matters, comes from you, God. Your blessing is all over your people!

title: When Haters Keep Hating, But God's Got Your Back
paragraphs: God, when I call out, please answer me. You've got my back, right? I remember that one time I was in a super tight spot, and you made a way for me. Well, I'm in trouble again. Please show me some grace and hear me out.
To all you haters out there—how long are you gonna keep disrespecting me? How long will you keep chasing after fake stuff and living in a fantasy world?
Check this out: God chose me. For real. He listens the exact moment I call out to him.
Go ahead and complain if you have to, but don't go off on people. Just be quiet and let your heart speak. Take your issues to God and wait for what he has to say.
Why is everyone always wanting more? It's like all they say is 'More, more, more.' But me? I've got more than enough with God. I find more joy in just a regular day...
...than they get from all their shopping sprees. When the day is over, I can sleep peacefully because you, God, have got my life all sorted out.

title: When Haters Are Loud, Pray Louder
paragraphs: God, for real, please listen up! I know I'm just rambling and groaning, but can you hear me out? You're my King and my God, and I seriously need your help. I'll be hitting you up every single morning. I'm laying my whole life out for you, like a sacrifice, just waiting for you to show up and do something amazing.

You're not friends with bad people, and you definitely don't invite evil to hang out. People who are all talk just fall apart when they're around you. You're so done with troublemakers. God, you shut down liars, and people who are violent and twist the truth are just gross to you.

And now I'm here, and you invited me! That's wild. I'm walking into your house, and I'm just bowing down in your most holy place, waiting for you to tell me how to get past all the people who are against me.

Everything they say is like a trap, and their words are like poison. They're all about death and destruction, and their words are slippery and will make you fall. God, make them face the consequences. Let their own smarts be their downfall. Just kick them out, they've had enough chances.

But for those of us who run to you for safety, you'll welcome us with open arms. Let's party all night! Watch over our celebration. God, you're famous for being good to those who look for you, for decking us out in pure joy.

title: God, I'm legit at my limit
paragraphs: God, for real, stop yelling at me. I can't take another lecture.
Just be nice for a change; I'm starving for some affection.
Can't you see I'm all beat up, like, my bones and my soul are black and blue? God, how long till you let up?
Jump in, God, and break this up. If you love me at all, you gotta get me out of here. I'm no good to you dead, right? I can't be in your praise team if I'm six feet under!
I'm so over all of this—legit exhausted. My bed's been floating for like, 40 days and nights on my tears. My mattress is soaked.
My eyes are just dark circles at this point, I'm basically blind and just feeling my way around.
Get out of here, all you haters. God finally heard me crying. He said yes to all my requests, my prayers got answered.
My enemies are such cowards, they're just gone. They totally bailed, disgraced. Wild.

title: When They're Spreading Lies About You
paragraphs: God! My God! I'm running to you for dear life, for real. The chase is wild and if they catch me, I'm finished. I'll be ripped to shreds by enemies as fierce as lions, dragged off, and no one will even come looking for me.

God, if I actually did what they're accusing me of—like betraying my friends or ripping off my enemies—if my hands are really that dirty, then fine. Let them catch me, walk all over me, and leave me face down in the dirt.

Get up, God! Unleash your holy anger against my furious enemies. Wake up, God! The courtroom is packed with my accusers; it's judgment time. Take your seat on the judge's bench, grab your gavel, and throw out all the fake charges they've made against me. I'm ready for your verdict and confident you'll say I'm innocent.

Shut down the book on Evil, God, but give us the guide on how to live right. You get us ready for life by checking our weak spots and smoothing out our rough edges. And I'm feeling so good, so safe, because you made me right and you keep me right. God is super serious about doing the right thing, but all this evil is really getting on His nerves.
Nobody gets away with anything. God is already on it—His sword is sharpened, His bow is strung with an arrow ready to fly. He's got lethal weapons in hand, and every arrow is like a flaming missile.
Look at that guy! He's so into his sin, it's like he got pregnant with evil. And oh, look! He's giving birth—to a baby made of lies!

See that man digging a trap day after day, then hiding it on some lonely road? If you go back and look, you'll see him stuck in it headfirst, with his legs kicking in the air. That's what happens: your bad deeds backfire, and your violence comes right back at you like a boomerang.
I'm thanking God because He makes things right. I'm going to sing about how famous the God of heaven is.

title: You're a BIG Deal (But So Are We?!)
paragraphs: God, our awesome Lord, your name is famous everywhere.
Even babies and little kids are singing your praises, so loud that it shuts up all the haters and people who say you're not real.

When I look up at the huge night sky you made—like, this massive, dark, handmade masterpiece, with the moon and stars like your personal jewelry collection—and then I look at tiny little me, I can't help but wonder: Why do you even bother with us? Why do you give us a second glance?

And yet, it's wild that you made us just a little lower than angels, shining bright like we're straight out of Eden. You put us in charge of the whole world you created. You told us to take care of it, just like in Genesis. We're the managers of all the sheep and cows, and even the wild animals, the birds in the sky and the fish in the sea, and the whales singing way down deep.
God, our awesome Lord, your name echoes all over the planet.

title: God's Ultimate Comeback
paragraphs: I'm giving you a massive shoutout, God, straight from the heart. I'm basically writing a whole book about all the awesome things you do. I'm so hyped I'm whistling, laughing, and jumping for joy. I'm singing your song, High God.
The day my enemies dipped, they tripped over you and totally face-planted. You came in and sorted everything out. When I was in a jam, you were there, taking charge.

You totally call out the nations that don't mess with you. You kick the dirty players out of the game and just delete their names from the list. Enemies just vanish from the scene, their rep is wrecked, and their names are erased from the history books.
God's the one in charge, he sees the whole world's mess and fixes it. He decides what's fair for all of us on earth and makes sure everyone gets what's coming to them.
God is a total safe space for the broken, a sanctuary when times are rough. The second you show up, you can just chill. You'll never be sorry you came to him.
Sing songs to God who lives in Zion, tell everyone you know about his story. He's the one who hunts down the bad guys but still keeps an eye on us, noticing every single time we're down.

Have my back, God. I've been getting beat up for way too long. Once you pull me back from the edge, I'll write a whole book of praise. I'll throw a party on the main street, I'll lead the songs, and we'll fill the air with songs about how you saved us.

The godless countries are trapped in the very traps they set. Their own feet are tangled in the nets they laid out. They have no excuse; everyone knows how God works. The sneaky plans the wicked made ended up hurting themselves.

The wicked are on a one-way trip to hell. The poor won't be forgotten anymore—no more being looked down on for the humble. Get up, God! Aren't you sick of their arrogant act? Expose them for who they really are! Shake them up, God! Show them how ridiculous they look.

title: God, You There? The Bullies Are Winning RN
paragraphs: God, where are you? It feels like you're ignoring me right when I need you most.
These arrogant bullies are on the hunt for anyone they see as weak, and they're not being subtle about it. It's time for their own traps to backfire on them.

The wicked are all talk, super proud of their messed-up plans and always dissing God. They're so full of themselves, they act like God doesn't even exist, basically spray-painting "You can't stop me" and "God's irrelevant" everywhere.

They seriously don't care what you think. If you're in their way, they'll just brush you off. They're living in their own little fantasy world, thinking, "We're untouchable. Nothing can go wrong for us."
Their words are like a curse, and they're always spitting venom. They blend in with the crowd and then, bam, they ambush innocent people.
They target the people who are already down on their luck, hiding and waiting like a predator. As soon as some poor soul gets close, they attack without a second thought.
The victim gets totally crushed, beaten down and left for dead. They start to think God has bailed on them, that He's just looking the other way.

Okay God, for real, it's time to step up. Do something. The people who are suffering think you've forgotten them. They're wondering how the wicked can get away with dissing you, how they're so sure they'll never have to face the consequences.
But you see it all—the disrespect, the pain. And I'm holding out hope that the unlucky will finally catch a break with you. You're not gonna let them down; the orphans won't be left alone forever.
It's time to break the power of the wicked, every last bit of it. Go on a search-and-destroy mission against all their evil. In the end, God's goodness wins; their godless world is gonna lose.

Suddenly, the victim's pulse gets stronger. The hopeless start to feel alive again because you're actually listening to them. The orphans find a family, the homeless find a place to belong. The reign of terror is over. The rule of the bullies is done.

title: No Cap, God's Got Your Back
paragraphs: I'm already all-in with God, so why are you telling me to run for the hills? You're like, "Dude, get out of here! Bad guys are everywhere, hiding in the shadows, waiting to take down anyone who loves God. Society's a mess, and good people are getting wrecked."

But for real, God's not hiding on some mountain. He's still on His throne, watching everything. He sees it all, every single person, inside and out. He's checking everyone's hearts, both the good and the bad. And if you're a fake, He's not having it. If you fail His vibe check, you're gonna face some serious heat, like fiery rocks and scorching winds. It's gonna be rough.

But God's all about making things right. He loves justice and fairness. He's the one who helps us get our lives straight. And when we're living right, we can look at Him with confidence, no need to hide.

title: God, Where'd All the Real Ones Go?
paragraphs: Quick, God, I need your help! It feels like all the good people are gone, like all my real friends have disappeared. Everyone's just lying to each other, saying whatever to get what they want. It's all fake, double-talk.
Seriously, shut them up! I'm so over hearing them brag about how they can manipulate anyone. They think their words run the world.
But then, God sees the poor and the homeless, groaning in the streets, and he says, 'I've seen enough. I'm coming to fix the broken hearts of the miserable.'

God's words are the real deal, like pure silver that's been through the fire seven times. They're as real as it gets. So God, protect us from all the liars, from the wicked people who are always trying to trick us, the ones who get praised for their awesome lies.

title: God, You There? Feeling Lowkey Ghosted
paragraphs: Seriously God, how long are you gonna ignore me? Feels like I've been staring at the back of your head forever. I'm so over carrying all this stress and this pit in my stomach. And I'm sick of my enemies acting like they're all that.
Please, God, my God, just look at me. I need to face this head-on, so my enemies don't get the win and laugh when I totally wipe out.
But for real, I'm trusting you completely. I'm ready to celebrate you saving me. I'm gonna be singing my heart out because you came through.

title: God's Got Your Back, No Cap
paragraphs: These arrogant people are out here saying, "God's not real." Seriously? Their words are toxic, like they're polluting everything. All they produce is negativity.
So God looks down from heaven, searching for anyone with a clue, anyone who's actually looking for Him.
But He finds no one. It's a total bust. They're like a bunch of lost sheep trying to lead each other, just following the crowd.
Do these bullies even get it? They treat people like they're disposable, like a quick snack they can't even be bothered to be thankful for. They really think they can get away with that?
Well, a storm is coming for them. God's on the side of the people they hurt. They think they can crush the dreams of the struggling? Nah, God's the one who makes those dreams happen.
So, who's gonna save the day? God is. He's the one who turns everything around. Jacob will be dancing, and all of Israel will be celebrating.

title: God's honored Guest List
paragraphs: Yo God, who gets to crash at Your place? How do I get on the guest list?
“Basically, just be a good person. Be real, do the right thing, and always tell the truth.
“Don’t backstab your friends or spread rumors about your neighbors. And yeah, you should totally despise people who do messed-up stuff.
“Keep your promises, even when it’s hard. Earn your money honestly, and never, ever take a bribe to do something shady.
“If you live like that, you’ll always be welcome here.”

title: God is My #1, No Cap
paragraphs: Yo God, for real, keep me safe. I'm running to you like my life's on the line. I'm telling you, "You're my Lord!" Without you, nothing even makes sense.
And all these people you've chosen? They're the best friends ever.
Don't just go shopping for a god like they're on sale. You can't just buy a god. I swear I'll never treat God's name like it's just some brand.
My choice is you, God, first and only. And now I find out I'm your choice too! You hooked me up with a house and a yard. And then you made me your heir! That's goated.
The smart advice God gives me when I'm awake is the same stuff my heart tells me in my sleep. Day and night, I'm sticking with God. I've got a good thing going and I'm not letting go.
I'm happy from the inside out, and from the outside in, I'm solid. You basically cancelled my ticket to hell—that's not where I'm going!
Now you've got my feet on the path of life, and I'm glowing from your presence. Ever since you took my hand, I know I'm on the right track.

title: My Uncancelable Prayer to God
paragraphs: Yo God, for real, listen up. This is the realest prayer you're ever gonna get. Show everyone I'm not in the wrong—you already know what's up, deep down.
Go on, check my heart, test me whenever. You'll see I'm legit. I don't just say things.
I'm not about that worldly hustle. I'm trying to live by your rules, your Word. I'm following your lead, one step at a time. I'm not quitting.
I'm hitting you up, God, 'cause I know you'll answer. So... answer me! Hear me out, for real. Show your amazing grace, and protect your kids who are running from the haters straight to you.
Keep an eye on me, protect me. Hide me from the evil people who are trying to take me down, from the enemies all around me.

These guys are ruthless, all talk and hate. They're chasing me, trying to bring me down like lions about to pounce. Get up, God! Face them, shut them down! Save me from them. Take down these people who only care about today and can't see the bigger picture.
I hope they get what's coming to them, a taste of their own medicine. Let them and their families feel the consequences of their actions.
But me? I'm gonna see you face-to-face. When I wake up, I'll see you in all your glory, and that'll be my heaven on earth.

title: My Ultimate Bodyguard
paragraphs: I love you, God—you're my strength. You're the solid ground under my feet, the fortress where I'm safe, my hero who rescues me. My God is the high cliff I run to for safety, hiding behind the rocks, totally secure in my granite hideout.
I just call out to God, who's worthy of all the praise, and boom—I'm safe and saved.
The ropes of death were wrapped around my neck; terrifying floods were washing over me. The chains of the underworld had me trapped; death was waiting at every corner.
In this messed-up world, I call out to God; I cry to God to help me. From his palace, he hears my call; my cry gets me a private audience right in front of him.

The earth started shaking and swaying; huge mountains trembled like leaves, quaking because He was so angry. Smoke flared from his nose; fire shot out of his mouth. Flames were darting everywhere. He pulled the sky down and stepped on it; a deep abyss opened up under his feet. He was riding a winged creature, flying on the wings of the wind. Then he wrapped himself in darkness, like a trench coat made of black clouds. But his brightness burst through the clouds, sending down hail and fireballs. Then God's voice thundered from heaven; the Most High God shouted, and more hail and fireballs rained down. God shot his arrows, and everyone panicked. He threw his lightning, and they were totally defeated. The hidden sources of the ocean were exposed, and the secret depths of the earth were laid bare the moment you roared, God, unleashing your hurricane-like anger.

But he reached down from the sky and grabbed me; he pulled me out of that deep water of hate, that chaotic mess of enemies where I was drowning. They attacked me when I was at my lowest, but God had my back. He set me on a wide-open space; I was saved—and surprised that I was so loved!

God put my life back together when I laid it all out for him. When I got my act together, he gave me a fresh start. Now I'm paying attention to God's ways; I don't take him for granted. I think about how he works every day; I try not to miss a thing. I feel whole again, and I'm watching where I'm going. God basically rewrote my life story when I let him see what was in my heart.

Good people get to experience your goodness. Healthy people experience your health. Honest people experience your truth. But the bad guys just can't figure you out. You stand up for the people who are down, but you bring the arrogant people down a peg.
Suddenly, God, you light up my life; I'm shining with God's glory! I can break through gangs of enemies; I can jump over the highest walls.
What a God! His path is straight and perfect. Every instruction from God is tried and true. Everyone who runs to him for safety makes it.

Is there any god like our God? Isn't He the solid rock we stand on? This is the God who gave me strength and pointed me in the right direction. Now I can run like a deer; I'm the king of the mountain. He taught me how to fight; I can bend a bow made of bronze! You protect me with your armor of salvation; you hold me up with a strong hand and treat me with gentle kindness. You cleared the path for me so I wouldn't stumble. When I chased my enemies, I caught them; I didn't stop until they were finished. I took them down; they were defeated for good, and then I walked all over them. You gave me strength for the battle; you crushed those who rose up against me. You made my enemies run away, and I destroyed all the haters. They cried for help, but no one came; they yelled for God, but got no answer. I crushed them into dust that blew away in the wind. I threw them out like trash in the street.

You rescued me from my own people who were fighting; you made me the leader of nations. People I didn't even know served me; as soon as they heard about me, they obeyed. Foreign enemies gave up; they came crawling out of their hiding places on their stomachs.

God is alive! Blessings to my Rock, my God who sets me free and stands tall! This God made things right for me and silenced the people who talked trash. He rescued me from my angry enemies, he lifted me out of the reach of my attackers, he saved me from bullies.

That's why I'm thanking you, God, all over the world. That's why I'm singing songs that praise your name. God's king wins the prize; God's chosen one is loved. I'm talking about David and all his descendants—forever.

title: God's Word is Fire, No Cap
paragraphs: God’s glory is on a world tour across the skies, and the whole horizon is like a massive art show of His work. Every single morning, Day is holding class, and every night, Night is giving a lecture.

You can't actually hear their words, and their voices aren't being recorded, but their silence is so loud it fills the entire planet. It's like this unspoken truth that's being shouted everywhere, you feel me?

God made this huge dome for the sun—like a superdome! The morning sun is like a new husband, hyped and jumping out of his honeymoon bed. The sun at dawn is like an athlete sprinting for the finish line.
That's pretty much how God's Word travels across the sky from when you wake up to when you go to bed. It melts ice, scorches deserts, and warms hearts, getting people to believe.

God's revelation is the whole deal; it pulls your life together. His signs are super clear, showing you the right way to go. God's life-maps are always right, leading you to joy. His directions are simple and easy to see. God's reputation is like 24-karat gold with a lifetime guarantee. His decisions are accurate down to the smallest detail.
God's Word is better than a diamond, even better than a diamond set in emeralds. You’ll like it more than fresh strawberries in the spring, more than perfectly ripe, red strawberries.

And there's more: God's Word warns you about danger and shows you where the hidden treasure is. Otherwise, how would we find our way? Or know when we're being fools? God, wipe the slate clean so we can start the day fresh! Keep me from doing dumb stuff, from thinking I can do Your job. Then I can start this day feeling brand new, scrubbed clean from all my mistakes. These are the words I'm saying, the things I'm thinking about and praying. Please accept them when I offer them to you this morning, O God, my Rock, the Priest of my altar.

title: God's Got Your Back, No Cap
paragraphs: When you're having a total meltdown, hope God answers your call. May the name of Jacob's God be your ultimate shield, keeping you safe from all the drama.

Hope he sends backup from his holy place and hooks you up with fresh supplies from Zion. May he be super impressed with your efforts and totally hype about your sacrifices. Hope he gives you everything your heart wants and makes all your plans happen.
When you get that W, we're gonna go wild and party hard, waving our banners for our God. Seriously, may all your wishes come true!
I know help is on the way. An answer is coming, and everything's gonna be alright.

Look at those people flexing with their fancy chariots and grooming their horses. But us? We're all about our God. Their chariots will end up as scrap metal and their horses will go lame, but we'll be standing strong, totally unfazed.
God, make our king a winner. The day we call out to you, please answer us. It's a vibe.

title: When God's Got Your Back
paragraphs: God, your strength is the king's strength, for real. With your help, he's shouting out your name. You gave him everything he asked for. You loaded him up with gifts and gave him the special treatment. He just wanted a good life, and you gave him that and a long one too, like a bonus level. You made him shine bright like a star and decked him out in all the best colors. You keep blessing him and make him happy when you smile. It's no wonder the king messes with you, God. He's sticking with the GOAT.

You've got all his enemies and haters in your hands. You're so powerful, they can't even look at you, like they're staring into a furnace. Then, whoosh, the furnace swallows them up, and the fire burns them alive. You get rid of all their kids from the earth and wipe the slate clean. All their sneaky plans and evil plots? Total fails. You sent them running because they couldn't handle you.
Flex on 'em, God, so everyone can see your power. We're out here singing about how awesome you are!

title: Worst Day Ever... But Then God Showed Up 🤯
paragraphs: My God, my God... seriously, why did you just leave me out here in the middle of nowhere? I'm doubled over in pain, screaming for you all day long, but get no answer. Nothing. I keep going all night, just tossing and turning.

And You! Are you just chilling, not caring about any of this, just kicking back while everyone in Israel sings your praises? We all know you came through for our ancestors; they cried out to you for help, and you delivered. They put their trust in you and lived their best lives.

But look at me, I'm a total nobody—like a worm, something people step on without a second thought. Everyone makes fun of me; they pull faces and shake their heads, saying, 'Let's see how God gets him out of this one. If God likes him so much, let's see Him help him!'

And to think, you were the one who delivered me at birth, who made me feel safe with my own mom. From the moment I was born, you held me; you've been my God since day one. But then you felt so far away, and trouble moved in right next door. I really need a good neighbor right now.
I've got whole herds of bulls coming at me, a full-on stampede of angry bulls, with their horns down and nostrils flaring, like a wild buffalo herd on the loose.

I feel like a bucket that's been kicked over and spilled everywhere; every single joint in my body feels like it's been pulled apart. My heart has literally melted into a puddle in my stomach. I'm as dry as a bone, my tongue is black and swollen. They've basically laid me out in the dirt to be buried.

Now there are packs of wild dogs coming after me; a whole gang of thugs is surrounding me. They've got me pinned down, hand and foot, and locked me in a cage. I'm just a bag of bones in a cage, with every person passing by just staring. They took my wallet and the shirt right off my back, and now they're gambling for my clothes.

God, please don't wait to rescue me! Hurry up and help me out! Don't let them slit my throat; don't let those dogs eat me. If you don't show up soon, it's over for me—I'll be gored by the bulls, just meat for the lions.

This is the story I'm going to tell my friends when they all come to worship, and I'll be shouting Hallelujah through it all: 'Shout Hallelujah, all you who worship God; give glory, all you sons of Jacob; worship Him, all you daughters of Israel. He has never, ever let you down, never looked the other way when you were getting kicked around. He never just wandered off to do His own thing; He was right there the whole time, listening.'

Right here in this huge worship gathering, I've discovered this life of praise. And I'm going to do what I promised, right here in front of everyone who worships God. The people who have nothing will sit at God's table and eat until they're full. Everyone who's searching for God is here, praising Him. 'Live it up, for real. Don't ever stop!'

From every corner of the earth, people are starting to get it, they're all running back to God. Families that were lost for ages are now bowing down and worshiping Him. God has taken over; from now on, He gets the final say.
All the powerful people are bowing before Him—worshiping! And all the poor and powerless people are too—worshiping! Even those who could never get their life together—they're all worshiping!

Our kids and their kids will be a part of this, as the story gets passed down from parent to child. Babies who haven't even been conceived yet will hear the good news—that God always does what He says He'll do.

title: God's Got My Back, No Cap
paragraphs: God is my shepherd, so I'm totally set. I don't need a thing.
He lets me chill in lush green fields and leads me to quiet streams to drink. He gets my life back on track and points me in the right direction, just like he promised.
Even when I'm walking through the darkest valley, like, legit scary stuff, I'm not afraid because you're right there with me. Your shepherd's staff and rod make me feel super safe and protected.
You throw a massive feast for me right in front of my haters. You anoint my head with oil, and my cup is overflowing with blessings. It's a whole vibe.
For real, your goodness and love are gonna chase after me every single day of my life. And I'll be chilling in God's house forever..

title: Who Gets to Vibe with God?
paragraphs: God basically owns the Earth and everything in it, the whole world and every single person. He built it on top of the oceans and set it on the rivers, which is pretty wild.
So, who gets to climb God's mountain? Who can even get into His holy place? It's the people with clean hands and a pure heart. The ones who don't chase after fake idols or lie just to get ahead.
They're the ones who get blessed by God; they're the ones their Savior helps out. That's the crew that's all about seeking Him—the generation that's looking for the God of Jacob.
So open up, you city gates! Swing wide, you ancient doors! The King of Glory is coming in.
And you ask, 'Who is this King of Glory?' He's the LORD, strong and a total warrior, the LORD, a beast in battle.
So open up, you city gates! Swing wide, you ancient doors! The King of Glory is coming in.
'So, who IS this King of Glory?' He's the LORD of all the angel armies. He's the King of Glory..

title: God, You Got My Back, Right?
paragraphs: I’m looking to you, God, keeping my head high. I’m done with feeling down and hiding.
I’m all in with you, so you won’t let me be embarrassed, right? You won’t let my enemies get the W?
Don’t let any of us who are counting on you be embarrassed. The only ones who should be humiliated are the traitors.
Show me how you operate, God; teach me your ways.
Take my hand and lead me in your truth. You’re my Savior, after all, aren’t you?
Remember your mercy and love, God; they’ve been around forever.
Forget the wild things I did when I was young. Instead, remember me because of your love. Plan only the best for me, God!
God is fair and just; he gets people who are lost back on the right track.
He takes the side of the underdog and shows them the way, step-by-step.
Every path you take will lead you to God. Just follow the signs of the covenant and read the directions.
Keep your reputation solid, God, and forgive my messed-up life. It’s been a really bad one.
So what are God-worshippers like? They’re like arrows hitting God’s bull’s-eye.
They find a good place to settle down, and their kids inherit a great life.
Friendship with God is for those who worship him; he tells them his secrets.
If I keep my eyes on God, I won’t trip over my own feet.
Look at me and help me out! I’m all alone and in serious trouble.
My heart and my head are at war with each other; please call a truce to this internal battle.
Take a good look at my hard life, and then lift this huge weight of sin off me.
Do you see how many people are out to get me? They hate me with a passion.
Watch over me and keep me out of trouble. Don’t let me down when I run to you for help.
Use all your skills to put me back together; I’m waiting to see what you’ll make of me.
God, please give your people a break from this streak of bad luck.

title: Keeping It 100 With God
paragraphs: God, for real, back me up. I've been trying to live right and I'm all in with You, not going anywhere.
Go ahead and check me, God. Put me to the test. See if I'm legit, inside and out.
Your love is always on my mind, and I'm trying to walk with you, step for step.
I don't mess with fake people or hang with bad crowds. I can't stand those who just cause trouble, and I'm not about that double-crossing life.
I'm making sure I'm clean, not just my hands but my heart. Then I'll join everyone else, worshiping you, singing out loud, and telling everyone how great you are.
God, I love being in your presence; it's where your glory shines. When you clean house, don't throw me out with the fakes and the corrupt people, the ones who are all about dirty deals and bribes.
You know I've been straight up with you, so be straight with me. I'm on your side, God, and I'll praise you every chance I get.

title: No Fear When God's Here
paragraphs: God is my light, my space, and all my energy. With him on my side, I'm fearless, not scared of anyone or anything.
When haters and bullies come at me, trying to tear me down, they're the ones who end up stumbling and falling.
Even if a whole army surrounds me, I'm not worried. Even if a war starts, I'll stay confident.
I've asked God for one thing, and it's the only thing I really want: to live in his house for my whole life. I want to see how beautiful he is and hang out in his temple.
Because when things get rough, he'll keep me safe. He'll hide me in his home and lift me up high on a rock where no one can reach me.
Now I can stand tall above all the enemies around me. I'll celebrate in his house, singing and making music for God.
Hey, God, listen to me when I shout for help! Be kind and answer me.
My heart tells me to look for you, and I'm doing it! So please, don't hide from me. Don't be angry and push me away. You've always been my helper, so don't leave me now. You're the God who saves me.
Even if my own mom and dad left me, God would take me in.
God, show me the right way to live. Make the path clear for me, because my enemies are watching. Don't let them get me. They're telling lies and threatening me.
But I'm sure I'll see God's goodness right here, right now, while I'm alive.
So, trust in God! Be brave and strong. Don't give up. I'll say it again: trust in God.

title: Don't Leave Me on Read, God!
paragraphs: God, please don't ignore me when I'm calling out to you. If all I get from you is silence, I'd honestly be better off dead.
I'm laying it all out, calling for help, and reaching out to your holy place.
Don't throw me in with the bad crowd, with those people who basically work for evil full-time. They say all the right things about 'peace' but are secretly on the devil's team.
Give them what they deserve for all the messed-up things they've done. Make them pay for all the hours they've put in working for the devil, and then add a big bonus on top.
Because they have no clue how God works or what He's about, God's going to completely wreck them and just walk away from the mess.
But shoutout to God—He heard me praying. He proved He's on my side, so I'm sticking with Him for good.
Now I'm literally jumping for joy, shouting and singing my thanks to Him.
God is the ultimate strength for His people, a safe place for the leader He chose. Save your people and bless everything that is yours. Take care of them, and carry them like a good shepherd.

title: God's Thunder is Next Level
paragraphs: Yo, give it up for God! Angels, everyone, let's hear a massive 'Encore!' for Him. Seriously, just look at that glory, that power you can literally see. Stand up straight! Put on your best fit to show Him some respect!
God's voice is like thunder rolling over the water. His face and voice are so bright, just streaming light—that's God, ruling over the massive flood.
God's voice is like a sick drum beat, a whole symphony of sound.
His thunder is so powerful it can smash giant cedar trees, even the huge ones from up north.
The mountains start skipping around like young horses, and the high hills are jumping like wild baby goats.
God's thunder spits actual fire. His voice makes the entire wilderness tremble; He even makes the Kadesh desert shake.
God's thunder gets the oak trees dancing wildly, and the pouring rain strips their branches bare. We just fall to our knees and shout, 'Glory!'
God's throne is high above the floodwaters; that's where His power comes from, and that's how He rules the world.
God makes His people strong. And God gives His people peace. For real.

title: From Rock Bottom to Victory Dance
paragraphs: I'm giving you all the props, God. You pulled me out of a total disaster and didn't let my haters have the last laugh.
God, my God, I was screaming for help and you totally had my back. You literally saved me from death's door and gave me a second shot at life when I was at rock bottom.

Hey, all you believers! Let's get loud and sing for God! Thank him directly! Yeah, he might get mad sometimes, but his love is for a lifetime. Those nights you spend crying your eyes out will turn into days full of laughter, for real.
When everything was going my way, I was like, 'I'm set. I'm totally God's favorite. He made me the king of the world.' But then you looked away for one second, and my whole world came crashing down.

So I hit you up, God, and laid it all out: 'What good am I to you if I'm dead? You can't exactly make a profit off me at a graveyard garage sale, right? When I'm just dust, my songs and stories about you are worthless. So, please, just listen and help a guy out!'

And you did it! You turned my ugly crying into a victory dance. You ripped off my funeral clothes and dressed me up in something awesome. Now I can't stop singing; I have to tell everyone about you. God, my God, thank you so, so much.

title: When Life Hits Hard, God's My Ultimate Safe House
paragraphs: God, I'm running to you, for real. My life's on the line. Please don't turn away from me. You gotta take me seriously this time. Come down to my level and actually listen, and like, right now, no delays. Be my secret hideout, my safe spot high up where no one can get to me.

You're my go-to hiding spot, my rock and my fortress. Lead the way and be my guide through all this. Get me out of the traps people have set for me; I just want to be safe with you. My life is in your hands. I know you've got me, you'll never let me fall.

Honestly, I can't stand all the fake religious stuff, but you, God? You I trust. I'm so happy in your love it makes me want to dance. You saw I was hurting, you shut down my haters. You didn't just leave me there for them to get me, you gave me space to breathe. God, please be nice to me—I'm in some deep trouble again. I've cried so much my eyes are swollen shut, and I just feel empty. My life is just slipping away with every sad sigh. My problems have totally wrecked me, I feel like I'm turning to dust. My enemies act like I'm a freak, and the neighbors all make fun of me. My friends are scared of me; they literally cross the street to not have to see me. It's like they want to pretend I never existed, like I'm a dead body or a broken plate they can just throw away. The rumors going around are that I'm 'criminally insane'! They're all plotting behind my back to destroy me.

I'm desperate, so I'm throwing myself at you: you are my God! Every hour of every day, I'm putting my life in your hands, keeping it safe from the people who are trying to get me. Look at me, your follower, and smile. Save me because you love me. Don't make me look stupid by not being there for me; I've told you over and over I need you. Make the wicked people look stupid, leave them speechless as they go down to hell. Shut those liars up who are always heckling me, your follower, with their insults and mean jokes.

It's wild how many good things you have stored up for the people who worship you, just waiting for anyone who runs to you to get away from this messed-up world. You hide them away from all the haters. You shut the door on all the fake, mocking people and silence their toxic gossip. God is goated! His love is the most amazing thing in the world. When I was trapped and surrounded, I totally freaked out. I was like, 'He's forgotten about me.' But you heard me, you were listening.
Love God, all you who are close to him. God looks out for everyone who sticks with him, but he'll make sure those who are arrogant enough to do things on their own get what's coming to them.
Be brave. Be strong. Don't give up. God will be here before you know it.

title: The Ultimate Guide to a Fresh Start
paragraphs: Man, you're so lucky, seriously happy—you get a totally fresh start, a clean slate.
You're blessed—God isn't holding a grudge against you, and you're not hiding anything from Him.
When I kept it all bottled up, I felt like my bones were turning to dust, and I was groaning all day long.
The pressure was non-stop; I felt totally drained, like all the life was sucked out of me.
Then I just let it all out; I was like, “I’m gonna come clean to God about all my mess-ups.”
And just like that, the pressure was gone—my guilt just dissolved, and my sin disappeared.
This stuff adds up. Every single one of us needs to pray. When everything goes crazy and it feels like the world is ending, we’ll be safe on high ground, totally untouched.
God is my secret hideout, my safe island. He keeps all the danger away and showers me with shouts of victory.
Let me give you some real talk; I'm looking you right in the eye and telling you straight up:
“Don’t be stubborn like a horse or a mule that needs a bit and bridle just to stay on the right path.”
People who defy God are always getting into trouble, but those who trust God find themselves surrounded by love at every turn.
So celebrate God! Everyone sing together! All you who are real with yourselves, let's raise the roof!

title: God's Plan is Lowkey GOATED
paragraphs: Alright, all you good people, let's give it up for God! When you're living right, your praise just hits different. So grab your guitars and get on the piano, let's make some noise for Him! Write a whole new song for him; give him a trumpet fanfare.

Because God's Word is legit. Everything He makes is solid, inside and out. He loves when things are fair and just, when His world is perfectly aligned. The whole Earth is soaked in God's love and approval.
The skies were literally made by God's command. He just said the word, and boom, the stars appeared. He scooped up the Sea like it was nothing and stored the Ocean away.
Everyone on Earth, you gotta respect God. All you people in the world, show some reverence! Here's the deal: He spoke, and it just happened. It was there the second He said it.

God totally shuts down all that fake posturing and plotting. He dismantles the power-hungry schemes of the world. But God's own plan? It's solid. His designs are built to last forever. The country that has God on its side is seriously blessed; the people He's chosen are set for life.

From way up in the sky, God is watching everyone. He sees all of us. From his throne, he's got a perfect view of every single person on Earth. He created every individual, and now He's watching everything we do.
A king doesn't win just because he has a huge army, and a warrior isn't saved by their own strength. A powerful horse isn't the answer, and you can't just muscle your way through life.

But check this out: God's eye is on those who respect Him, the ones who are counting on His love. He's always ready to rescue them when things get bad, and when times are tough, He makes sure they have what they need to survive.

So we're putting all our trust in God; He's literally everything we need. And because of that, our hearts are bursting with joy, because we've put our faith in His holy name. God, just shower us with your love—that's all we're asking for, that's what we're depending on.

title: God's Got Your Back, No Cap
paragraphs: I'm gonna praise God every chance I get; my lungs are basically overflowing with praise for him.
I'm all about God; if you're going through it, listen up and get ready to be happy:
Come on, join me in spreading the word; let's tell everyone how great he is together.
God met me more than halfway; he totally freed me from all my anxious thoughts.
Look to him; give him your biggest smile. Don't ever hide how you're feeling from him.
When I was at my lowest, I called out, and God pulled me out of a super tight spot.
God's angel literally sets up a force field of protection around us while we're praying.
Just give it a try, open your eyes and see—how good God is. You're seriously blessed if you run to him for help.
Worship God if you want the best things in life; worship is the key that unlocks all his goodness.
Even young lions get hungry when they're on the hunt, but people who seek God are filled up with God himself.
Come here, kids, listen up; I'm about to give you a lesson on how to worship God.
Is there anyone out there who just loves life? Who can't wait to see beautiful things every single day?
Watch your mouth, don't use bad language, and stop telling lies.
Turn away from doing wrong; do something good. Chase after peace—don't let it get away!
God keeps a close watch on his friends; his ears are tuned in to every single one of their cries.
God has zero tolerance for rebels; he'll kick them out of the group.
Is anyone crying out for help? God is listening, and he's ready to come to the rescue.
If your heart is broken, you'll find God is right there with you; if you feel like you've been punched in the gut, he'll help you breathe again.
Followers of God get into trouble a lot, but still, God is there for them every single time.
He's like your personal bodyguard, protecting every single bone; you won't even get a broken finger.
The wicked are slowly destroying themselves; they waste their lives hating on good people.
God pays the price to set each of his servants free; no one who runs to him for protection will lose out.

title: My Enemies are Haters, God
paragraphs: God, go after these hecklers, for real. Just punch these bullies in the nose. Grab whatever You can find and stand up for me! Get ready to fight the people who are trying to cancel me. Just tell me You'll save me, that's all I need to hear.

When those thugs try to backstab me, make them look like total fools. Mess up the plans of everyone trying to bring me down. Make them like dust in a hurricane, with Your angel blowing them away. Make their path dark and slippery, with Your angel right behind them. They set a trap for me for no good reason, just because they're haters. Let them get caught in their own trap, the one they planned for me.
But let me be free and celebrate everything You do. Every part of me will be shouting, “God, no one is like You! You help the helpless and protect the weak from bullies!”
Random accusers just show up and start attacking me. I'm good to them, and they repay me with misery, leaving me feeling empty inside.

When they were sick, I was genuinely sad for them. I even stopped eating and just prayed. My prayers were heavy, like I’d lost my best friend. I was completely devastated, like a kid who lost their mom.
But when I was the one who was down, they threw a party! All the nobodies in town came to insult me. They trashed my reputation like it was nothing.

God, how long are you just going to stand there and watch? Save me from their cruelty; I feel like I'm being thrown to the lions. I’ll give you all the credit when we're all at church. When everyone shows up, I'll be shouting Hallelujah.

Don't let these liars, my enemies, celebrate because I'm struggling. They hate me for no reason, and they're not even trying to hide it. Nothing good comes from people like that; they spend all their time stirring up drama against people who are just trying to live their lives. They just mock me and say, “Haha, we caught you!”
God, You see what they're doing, right? You're not going to let them get away with this, are You? You're not just going to leave me hanging, right?

Please, get up and do something! Take care of my case. My God, my Lord—my life is on the line. Do what's right, my God, but don't let them have a good time at my expense. Don't let them think, “Yes, we got what we wanted.” Don't let them say, “We destroyed him.” Make the people who are laughing at me look ridiculous. Humiliate them for acting so high and mighty.

But for those who support me, let them be the ones who get the last laugh—a happy shout! Let them say over and over, “God is great—he always wants the best for his servant.” I’ll tell everyone how great and good You are. I’ll be shouting Hallelujah all day, every day.

title: Good Vibes vs. Bad Guys
paragraphs: That person who turns away from God is all about that bad vibe life—always ready to mess up. They have zero respect for God, just straight-up defiant. They've hyped themselves up so much they actually think no one will ever catch their shady stuff. The words that come out of their mouth are just gross, like dirty dishwater. They probably can't even remember the last time they did something good. Every night, they're dreaming up new ways to be awful. When they're out and about, nobody is safe. They're playing with fire and couldn't care less who gets burned.

God's love is wild, his loyalty is off the charts. His plans are huge, and his judgments are deep like the ocean. But even though he's so massive, nothing gets missed; not a single person, not even a mouse, falls through the cracks.

Your love is unreal, O God! We're so ready to just run and hide under your wings, to get our fill at the feast you put out for us, while you top up our cups with water from Eden. You're like a fountain of crazy bright light, and you help us see the light too.

Keep on loving your crew; do your thing in hearts that are open to you. Don't let the haters push me around, or let those small-minded people smack me down. Make those arrogant people fall flat on their faces in the mud.

title: Why Haters Never *Actually* Win
paragraphs: Don't even sweat the show-offs or get jealous of the shady people who seem to be winning. They'll be totally irrelevant faster than a forgotten meme, wilting like cut flowers left in the sun.
Trust in God, do good things, and just live your life, staying true to yourself. Vibe with God, and you'll get the best things in life.
Open up to God, be real with him; he'll handle whatever needs to be done. He'll make your goodness shine bright for everyone to see, and prove you're legit in the middle of the day.
Chill out in God's presence, and be patient. Don't get worked up about people who are climbing the social ladder by stepping on others.
Let go of your anger, ditch the rage, and cool down—it just makes everything a bigger mess. Sooner or later, the cheaters will go broke, but those who invest in God will basically own the place.

Before you know it, the wicked will be gone. You'll look for them, and it'll be like they were never there. But the humble, down-to-earth people will take over and enjoy some serious peace and prosperity.
Bad people are always plotting against the good ones, totally obsessed with taking them down. But God's not worried; he knows they're a joke with a terrible punchline.

Bullies love to show off their weapons, trying to look tough. They're out to hurt innocent people, like that nice person just trying to walk their dog. But it's like they slip on a banana peel and end up looking like clowns in a morality play.
Having less with God is way better than having a ton without him. One good person is stronger than fifty bad ones, because the wicked are spiritually weak, while the righteous are powered by God.
God keeps an eye on good people; the things they do have a lasting impact. When times get tough, they'll be fine; when everyone else's pantry is empty, theirs will be full.
People who hate on God are done for; God's enemies are finished. They'll be stripped clean like a vineyard after harvest and disappear like smoke.
The wicked borrow stuff and never give it back, but the righteous are always giving. The generous ones will get everything in the end, while the stingy get left behind.
A solid person walks in sync with God; their path is lit by him, and they're happy. If they trip, they won't be down for long because God's holding their hand.
I was young once, and now I'm old, but I've never seen a believer left behind or their kids begging on the streets. They're always giving and lending, and their kids make them proud.
Turn away from bad stuff, do good, and don't ever stop. God loves that, and he never abandons his friends.
Live like this, and you're set for life, but the bad apples will get thrown out. The good people will get good land and grow deep, healthy roots.

The righteous person thinks about wisdom all the time, like a dog with a favorite bone, and always talks about what's right. God's word is like blood in their veins; they're as steady and sure-footed as a cat.
The wicked are always watching the righteous, looking for a chance to take them out. But God is watching too, and he won't let a single hair on their head be harmed.
Wait for God with everything you've got, and stick to his path. He'll lift you up, and you'll get to see the wicked finally lose.
I once saw a wicked person who was puffed up and arrogant, talking all sorts of nonsense. The next time I looked, they were gone—like a popped balloon, totally empty and lame.

Keep your eyes on the person who is spiritually healthy and lives an honest life; there's a future in that kind of integrity. But the rebellious will be thrown away; people with bad attitudes are on a road to nowhere.
The big, free life comes from God, and he protects it. He gives us strength and saves us from evil—when we run to him, he's our safe place.

title: God, I'm Lowkey Spiraling RN
paragraphs: Yo God, take a deep breath, chill out for a sec. Don't be so quick with the punishments. Your sharp words are hitting hard, and your discipline is no joke—it actually hurts.

I'm so stressed from you calling me out that I've lost like twenty pounds in two months. My sin has left my bones feeling brittle, like dry sticks. I'm drowning in all the bad stuff I've done, totally crushed by an avalanche of guilt.

The wounds from my bad choices are getting nasty and infected because I've been living so reckless. And now I'm just face-down, feeling sorry for myself 24/7. My insides feel like they're on fire, and my body is a total wreck. I'm at my breaking point, I'm so over it—my whole life is just one long, painful groan.

God, you see everything I'm hoping for, it's all out in the open. My groans are nothing new to you. My heart is about to break; I'm completely burned out. It's like I'm blind to you and anything good. My old friends are avoiding me like the plague. My own family never visits, and my neighbors are straight-up backstabbers. My haters are trashing my name, literally praying for my downfall. But I'm just deaf and mute to it all, ears shut, mouth shut. I don't hear a word they're saying, and I'm not saying a word back. What I'm doing, God, is waiting for you. Waiting for my Lord, my God—I know you'll answer! I'm waiting and praying so they won't get to laugh at me, or walk off all smug when I stumble.

I'm right on the edge of losing it—the pain in my gut just keeps burning. I'm ready to own up to my story of failure; I'm done being proud of my sin. My enemies are out there and active, like a mob ready to take me down. I do good, and I get evil back from these God-haters who can't stand anyone who loves God.
Don't ditch me, God; my God, don't leave me hanging. Hurry up and help me; I need some breathing room in my life!

title: God, am I just... smoke?
paragraphs: I'm dead set on watching my every move and every word so I don't mess up. I decided to just keep my mouth shut whenever wicked people are around. I literally told myself, "Not a word," and stayed silent. But the longer I kept quiet, the worse it got—I was getting heated, for real. My thoughts were a mess, and I just had to spill.

"Yo God, what's the deal? How long do I even have? Just give me the bad news. You've got me on a super short leash; my life's way too short to be saved. It's wild, we're all just a puff of air. We're all just shadows at a bonfire. We're basically nothing. We grind to get all this stuff, and then we just leave it behind.

"So, what am I even doing right now, Lord? Just hoping, that's what. Hoping you'll rescue me from this rebel life, save me from getting roasted by fools. I'm done talking, I'll shut my mouth, 'cause you're the one behind all this, Lord. But I dunno how much more of this I can take. When you put us through it to burn away our sins, all our favorite things go up in smoke. Are we also just smoke?

"Please, God, hear my prayer, my cry for help—listen up. Don't be cold; just look at my tears. I'm like a foreigner here, totally lost. A wanderer, just like my whole family. Give me a break, cut me some slack before it's too late and I'm outta here."

title: God Pulled Me Out of the Mud, No Cap
paragraphs: I waited forever for God. Like, I was patient, and finally, He looked my way and listened. He literally pulled me out of a ditch, out of some nasty, deep mud. He set me up on solid rock so I wouldn't slip again. And get this—He gave me a brand new song to sing, a praise song to our God. Now, more and more people are seeing what He did, and they're starting to trust in God too. It's wild.

You're seriously blessed if you just trust God, ignore all the stuff the world says is a 'sure thing,' and don't worship what everyone else does. God's wonders and thoughts are a huge stockpile. No one and nothing can even compare to Him. I start talking about Him, telling people what I know, and I just run out of words. You can't count or describe how goated He is.
It's not about just doing stuff for You, or bringing You things. Being super religious and acting all pious? That's not what You're asking for. You've opened my ears so I can actually listen.
So I was like, 'I'm coming. I saw in Your book what You wrote about me, and I'm ready for the party You're throwing.' That's when God's Word really hit me and became a part of who I am.

I've told everyone about You, God. I haven't held anything back, and You know it. I didn't keep the news about Your ways a secret. I told everyone how dependable and thorough You are. I didn't keep Your love and truth to myself. I spilled all the tea and let everyone know the whole story.

So now, God, don't hold back on me. Don't hold back Your passion. Your love and truth are the only things keeping me together. When all my troubles ganged up on me, like a whole mob of past sins I can't even count, I was so overwhelmed with guilt I couldn't even see straight. I had more guilt in my heart than hair on my head, and it was so heavy my heart just gave out.

Please, God, soften up and step in. Hurry up and help me out. Make all the people trying to bring me down get embarrassed and lose face. Let anyone who enjoys seeing me miserable get heckled and disgraced. Let those who are hoping for my downfall get booed and jeered without any mercy.

But for everyone who's looking for You, let them sing and be happy. Let those who know what You're all about tell the world how great You are and that You never quit. As for me? I'm a mess. I'm basically nothing and have nothing. Please, make something out of me. You can do it; You've got what it takes. But please, God, don't wait.

title: When Your Bestie Betrays You
paragraphs: Seriously, props to you if you look out for people who are down on their luck. You’ll feel good about it—that’s how God works. God looks after all of us and makes us feel alive and kicking. We’re lucky to be in this land, free from worrying about our enemies. Whenever we’re sick in bed, God basically becomes our personal nurse and gets us back to health.

I said, “God, please be gracious and fix me—my sins have totally wrecked me.” My enemies are wishing the absolute worst for me; they’re probably placing bets on when I’ll finally die. If someone comes to visit, they just say a bunch of empty, nice-sounding words, but the whole time they’re just gathering gossip about me to spread around town. These so-called “friends” who actually hate me whisper slander about me everywhere. They literally form committees to plan how to make my life miserable.

The rumor going around is, “He’s got some gross, deadly disease. The doctors have already given up on him.” Even my best friend, the one I told everything to—he was always eating at my house!—has totally turned on me and stabbed me in the back.
God, please show me some grace and get me back on my feet. I’ll show them a thing or two.

Meanwhile, I’m 100% sure you’re on my side—my enemies aren’t celebrating just yet! You know me inside and out, you hold me together, and you never fail to help me stand tall in your presence so I can look you right in the eye.
Blessed is God, the God of Israel, forever and always. Yes. Yes. Yes.

title: When You're Lowkey Thirsty for God
paragraphs: Just like a deer gets thirsty and finds a stream, I'm thirsty for God. Like, really thirsty. I'm desperate to feel God's presence for real. I keep wondering, 'Am I ever gonna get there? To just be with God?'
I'm basically living on my own tears right now. Morning, noon, and night, that's all there is. And all day, people are bugging me, like, 'So, where's this God you're always talking about?'

I keep replaying the good old days in my head, you know? I used to lead the worship crew, right at the front. I was so hyped to get there and just praise God, shouting and singing, the whole squad celebrating together. It was a vibe.
So why am I so down now? Why all the sad vibes? I gotta focus on God. I know I'll be back to praising him soon. He's the one who makes me smile. He's my God, for real.

When I'm feeling depressed, I just run through everything I know about God. From the deepest valleys to the highest mountains. It feels like everything is just chaos, like I'm getting wrecked by giant waves. But then I remember God's promise to love me 24/7 and to sing over me all night. My whole life is basically a prayer to him.

Sometimes I gotta ask God, my rock, 'Yo, why have you forgotten me? Why am I out here crying, getting bullied by my haters?' These guys are ruthless, they're just roasting me day after day, saying, 'Where's your God now, huh?'
But for real, why am I so bummed out? Why am I so sad? I just need to focus on God. I know I'll be praising him again soon. He's the one who puts a smile on my face. He's my God.

title: When You Feel Ghosted by God
paragraphs: God, for real, back me up. Defend me from these people who are all shade and no love. Get me away from these liars and cheaters. I was counting on you, God. So why does it feel like you've ignored me? Why am I stuck here, just stressing and pacing over what these awful people are doing?

Send your light and your truth to show me the way. Be my GPS to your holy mountain, to the place where you live. I just want to get to your house, to worship and meet you, my amazing God. I want to break out my guitar and sing my thanks to you, my God, my everything.
So why are you so down, my soul? Why are you so bummed out? Just lock your eyes on God—I know I'll be back to singing his praises soon. He's the one who puts a smile on my face. He's my God.

title: God, You Ghosted Us?!
paragraphs: God, we've heard the stories our whole lives. Our dads told us what their dads told them—about how you, by yourself, totally kicked out the people who didn't follow you and set us up here. You made them bounce and gave us a clean slate. We didn't earn this land by fighting or working for it; it was a straight-up gift from you. You gave it to us with a huge smile, like you were super happy to do it.

You're my King, God—so give us the win! With you on our side, we'll crush our enemies. In your name, we'll turn them to dust. I'm not counting on weapons; my own skills won't save me. It's always been you who saved us from our haters and made them look like fools. We hype you up all day long, thanking you again and again.

But now, it feels like you've abandoned us. You've let us get embarrassed and you're not even fighting for us anymore. We had to retreat, and our enemies totally plundered us. It's like you handed us over to be slaughtered, and scattered us everywhere. You sold us out for cheap—like we were worthless.

Now everyone, even people we know, makes fun of us and calls us names. We're a running joke to those who don't believe in you. Every single day is a struggle, and I'm constantly reminded of our shame. All I hear is gossip and ridicule, and my enemies are everywhere.

All this is happening to us, and we didn't even do anything to deserve it. We never broke our deal with you; our hearts have always been loyal, and we never strayed from your path. So why are we getting tortured like this? Why are we locked up in this dark place?

If we had forgotten to pray to you, or started worshipping some fake, man-made gods, you would've known, right? You know everything about us. But no, it feels like you've decided to make us suffer, like we're just lambs being led to the slaughter every day.

Get up, God! Are you seriously going to sleep all day? Wake up! Don't you care what's happening to us? Why are you hiding from us? Why are you pretending everything's fine when it's clearly not? We're literally on the ground, getting stepped on. Get up and come save us. If you really love us, then help us!

title: The GOAT King's Epic Wedding
paragraphs: My heart is literally bursting with a beautiful and good song. I’m pouring it all out in this poem for the king, turning this river of feelings into words:

“You’re legit the most handsome guy out there; every word you say is pure grace, and God has blessed you, like, big time. Strap on your sword, warrior! Soak up the praise! Accept the honor you’re due! Ride on like a legend! Ride for what’s true! Ride for the humble and the right!
“Your words are like glow-in-the-dark instructions; you shoot sharp arrows straight into your enemies' hearts; the king's haters are left in the dust, totally beaten.

“Your throne is God’s throne, forever and ever; your royal scepter is all about living right. You love what’s right and hate what’s wrong. That’s why God, your own God, poured fragrant oil on your head, choosing you as king over all your friends.

“Your clothes smell amazing, like a forest breeze. The music from the throne room makes you want to bust a move. Princesses are in your court, and the Bride is straight-up glittering with gold jewelry.

“Now listen up, daughter, don’t miss a single word: forget your old life, leave your home behind. Be fully present—the king is totally wild for you. Since he’s your lord, adore him. People from Tyre are bringing wedding gifts; rich guests are showering you with presents.”

(Her wedding dress is dazzling, lined with gold by master weavers; all her dresses and robes are woven with gold. She’s led to the king, with her squad of virgin friends following. It’s a full-on parade of joy and laughter! What a grand entrance into the king’s palace!)

“Now, focus on having sons—don’t get hung up on your ancestors. You’ll make your sons princes all over the world. I’ll make you famous for generations; you’ll be the talk of the town for a long, long time.”

title: God's Got Your Back, No Cap
paragraphs: God is our ultimate safe spot, always ready to clutch up when we're in trouble. So we're not even sweating it, even if we're standing at the edge of total disaster. Bring on the crazy sea storms and earthquakes, the roaring oceans, and mountains literally shaking. We're fearless.

There's this river that brings so much joy, making God's city super chill. It's the sacred hangout of the Most High. Since God lives here, the streets are totally safe. He's on duty 24/7, right from the crack of dawn. Other nations can throw their tantrums, and all the kings and kingdoms can make their threats, but the Earth literally does whatever God says. Period.
The same God who wrestled with Jacob is on our team, and the God of the entire angel army has our back.

Yo, everybody, check this out! Look at the amazing things God does! He's the one planting flowers and trees all over the planet. He literally puts a stop to wars everywhere, from the North Pole to the South Pole, and snaps all the weapons in half like it's nothing. He's like, 'Yo, chill out for a sec. Stop rushing around. Take a good, long look at me. I'm your God, and I'm way above all the drama and politics, above everything.'
The same God who wrestled with Jacob is on our team, and the God of the entire angel army has our back.

title: God is the GOAT, No Cap
paragraphs: Yo, everybody, let's get wild! Clap your hands, go crazy! Shout out some awesome songs to God at the top of your lungs!

God, the Most High, is terrifying in the best way. He's the ultimate King, running the whole world, land and sea. He takes down anyone who comes against us and puts whole nations under our feet. He basically put us at the front of the line, his favorite, the honored ones he chose himself.
Listen to that! The cheers are going up as God ascends his mountain, with a massive blast from a ram's horn at the top. So sing to God, just keep singing! Sing to our King, give him all the praise!

He's the King of the whole planet, so you better bring your A-game and sing the best songs you've got. God is in charge of even the nations that don't know him. He's the sovereign King, sitting on his throne high above everything.
All the leaders from everywhere are gathering, the people of Abraham's God. All the power in the world belongs to God—he's flying high above it all.

title: God's City is Lowkey Invincible
paragraphs: God is seriously awesome, and in His city, the praise is non-stop. His holy mountain is breathtakingly high—it’s a joy for the whole world. Mount Zion, up in the north, is the city of the ultimate King. God in His fortress is straight up undefeatable.

So, these kings all teamed up and decided to attack. They took one look, and nope—they were out. They scattered and ran, totally bugging out. It hit them like intense cramps, the kind you get when you're having a baby.

You wrecked the powerful ships of Tarshish with a crazy storm from the east. We heard the stories, and then we saw it happen with our own eyes—right here in the city of God's Angel Armies, in the city our God built on a foundation so solid, it's gonna last forever.

We were just chilling in Your temple, God, thinking about all the amazing things You do. Your name is so famous, God, that people are singing Hallelujahs everywhere, far and wide. You're always doing good stuff for us.
So get hyped, Mount Zion! All you people of Judah, it's time to party! He actually did what He promised He would do!

Go take a walk around Zion, check out its defenses, and count all its towers. Take a good long look at its strong walls and climb up to its highest points. That way, you can tell the next generation the whole story, detail by detail, about our God. He's our God forever, and He'll be our guide until the very end.

title: Why Flex? You Can't Take It With You
paragraphs: Yo, world, listen up—every single person, don't miss this. Whether you're loaded or broke, you all need to hear this.

I'm about to drop some serious wisdom, stuff I've really thought through. I'm tuning in to the ancient secrets, and I'll spill the tea on life's biggest puzzle, all with my harp playing in the background.
So why should I be scared when things go south, when my enemies are trying to trip me up? Why would I let the rich and arrogant bullies get to me?

For real, you can't buy your way out of death. You can't just pull yourself up by your bootstraps. The price for eternal life is way out of our league, and even if you could pay it, there's no guarantee you'd dodge the grave forever.

It's a no-brainer that even the smartest, most talented people die, right along with the clueless and the foolish. They have to leave all their stuff behind and move into their new forever home: a coffin. The cemetery is their permanent address. And to think they were so important they named cities after themselves!
We're not immortal. Our time is short. We get old and weak, just like our pets. And then we die.

This is the deal for people who only live for the now and only care about themselves: Death is like a shepherd leading them straight to the underworld. They get swallowed up by the grave and just fade away. All that's left is a tombstone. But not me. God will rescue me from death's grip; He'll reach down and pull me up.

So don't be all impressed by people who get rich and famous. They can't take their money or their reputation with them when they die. It all gets left behind. They might think they've made it, with everyone telling them how great they are, but they'll end up in the family cemetery just like everyone else, and they'll never see the light of day again.
We're not immortal. Our time is short. We get old and weak, just like our pets. And then we die.

title: God Spills the Tea on Fake Worship
paragraphs: The God of all gods—yeah, THE God—is speaking up, shouting to the whole world, from where the sun rises to where it sets. From the epic glow of Zion, God just appears in a blaze of glory. Our God is making his entrance, and trust me, he's not being quiet about it. It's like a whole fireworks show is going off before him.
He's calling on heaven and earth to be the jury, 'cause he's taking his own people to court. He's like, "Go get my crew, the ones who made a deal with me and promised to be loyal."
The entire universe can confirm that this court is legit and that God himself is the judge.

"Yo, are you listening, my people? I'm about to speak. Israel, get ready, 'cause I'm putting you on trial. This is God, *your* God, talking. I'm not mad about your worship services or the sacrifices you keep offering. But for real, why would I want your prize-winning bull, or a bunch of goats from your flock? Every animal in the forest is already mine, all the wildlife on every mountain. I know every single bird, and even the field mice are my buddies. If I was hungry, you think I'd tell *you*? The whole world and everything in it is mine. You think I eat bull meat for dinner? Or drink goat blood? Nah. What you can give me is a feast of thankfulness. Keep the promises you made to the Most High God. Then, when you're in trouble, call me. I'll come through for you, and you'll give me the credit."
Next, God calls out the wicked people.

"So, what's your deal? You're out here quoting my rules and acting like we're best friends? You ignore me whenever I call, and you treat my words like they're trash. You see a thief and you're like, 'best friend!' You choose to hang out with people who cheat. Your mouth is just full of garbage, and you've turned lying into an art form. You'll even backstab your own brother and scam your own sister. I've been quiet while you did all this, and you thought I was cool with it. But now, I'm calling you out. I'm laying out all your messed-up actions right in front of you.

"Time's up. No more playing games with me. I'm about to give the verdict, and no one can save you. The life that really honors me is one full of praise. The second you start living the right way, I'll show you my salvation."

title: A Sinner's Glow-Up
paragraphs: God, you're so full of love, please show me some grace. You're incredibly merciful, so just erase my bad record. Seriously, scrub away my guilt, like a deep clean for my soul. I know I messed up big time; my mistakes are haunting me.

It's you I've wronged, and you saw everything, the whole ugly truth of what I did. You know the whole story, so whatever you decide is fair. I've been off-track with you for ages, basically since day one. You want real, deep-down honesty. So come in and start something new and real in me.

Give me a spiritual shower and I'll be sparkling clean. Scrub me down and my life will be like fresh snow. Let me hear some happy music again, let my broken self dance. Don't nitpick my flaws, just tell me I'm good to go. God, give me a total reset, turn the mess of my life into something amazing, like you did with creation. Don't just toss me aside, and please keep giving me that holy vibe. Rescue me from this bummer of an exile, get me excited about life again! Let me teach other screw-ups about you, so they can find their way back too. Save me from the death I deserve, my Savior God, and I'll be singing your praises 24/7. Open my mouth, dear God, and I'll shout out how awesome you are.

Just going through the motions doesn't impress you, and a perfect performance means nothing to you. I really started to get God-worship when my pride was totally crushed. God definitely notices when people have broken hearts and are ready for love.
