Make Zion your favorite place, and rebuild Jerusalem's broken walls. Then we'll give you real worship, not just faking it. We'll offer up everything, big and small, even all the bulls we can fit on your altar!

title: That 'Big Man'? Yeah, God's Gonna Wreck Him
paragraphs: So, why are you flexing so hard about being the bad guy, Mr. "Big Man"? God's mercy wins out in the end, for real. You're out here planning disasters, and your words are like a razor, you're a pro at lying. You're more into evil than good, saying what's wrong is right. You love to spread messed-up gossip, you've got a foul mouth.
God's gonna totally take you apart, sweep you up, and toss you out. He'll pull you up by the roots from the land of the living.

Good people are gonna see it and just be in awe of God. They'll laugh, so relieved, and be like, "Wow, that 'Big Man' totally bet on the wrong thing. He trusted his money and made a living off of other people's disasters."
But me? I'm like an olive tree, thriving in God's house. I've always trusted in God's huge mercy, and I always will.
I'll thank you forever because you took action. And I'm gonna stay right here, putting my hope in your good name, hanging with all your faithful friends.

title: Godless Fools Get Wrecked
paragraphs: These arrogant fools are running around saying, "God's not real." That's some toxic thinking, for real. They're corrupting themselves and everything around them; their whole vibe is just negativity and chaos. God's up in heaven, taking a look around. He's searching for anyone, even just one person, who isn't a total idiot—someone who's actually looking for Him, someone who's ready for God.
But He finds no one. It's a big fat zero. They're all useless, like a bunch of lost sheep trying to act like they're the shepherd. And everyone else just follows along like it's normal.
Do these predators even have a clue? Do they seriously think they can get away with treating people like a disposable fast-food meal, without even a moment of gratitude or prayer?
But a dark night is coming for them, a total nightmare they'll never wake up from. God is going to completely destroy these people who've taken over, and they'll be gone for good.
So who's gonna step up and save Israel? It's God who turns everything around. When He does, Jacob's crew will be jumping for joy, and all of Israel will be singing and laughing.

title: When Haters Try to Cancel You, But God's Your Ride or Die
paragraphs: God, for real, save me! Use your power to get me out of this.
God, please listen, I'm desperate. Don't be too busy to hear what I'm saying.
These haters are out to get me, and some seriously bad people are trying to take me down. They don't care about anything, and God means nothing to them.
But check it—God is right here helping me out! He's on my team.
The evil they planned is coming right back at them. So God, don't hold back! Finish them!
I'm so ready to worship you now. I'm thanking you, God—you're just that good. You've pulled me out of every single mess, and I got to watch my enemies get exactly what they deserved.

title: When Your Best Friend Becomes Your Worst Enemy
paragraphs: God, for real, listen to my prayer. Don't just ignore me. Come through and tell me what's up. I seriously need you. The nasty things they say about me are getting to me, and the dirty looks are terrifying. They just keep piling on the drama and spreading lies.

I feel like my world is falling apart; the fear of death is so real right now. I'm shaking all over. I keep thinking, "Can I just get some wings, like a dove or something?" I need to get out of here, find some peace and quiet. I'm dreaming of a chill walk in the country, or a cabin in the woods. I'm desperate to escape all this anger and chaos.

God, you gotta shut them down. Seriously. I can't believe how they've divided the whole city into rival crews that are always out looking for a fight, day and night. The streets are disgusting, and even the store owners are scamming people right in front of everyone.

This isn't some random bully making fun of me—I could handle that. This isn't some enemy from another country dissing me—I could ignore that. But it's you! We grew up together! You, my best friend! We spent so much time just chilling, walking and talking, and God was right there with us in our conversations.
Drag those traitors down to hell while they're still breathing. Let them get a taste of the horror. Let them feel how awful a cursed life is, down to the last detail.

I'm calling out to God, and I know he'll save me. Morning, noon, and night, I'm sighing and groaning, and he hears me. He rescues me. I'm safe and sound, even when I'm surrounded by danger and thousands of people are against me. God hears everything, and from his throne, he'll put them in their place. But they're so stuck in their ways, they won't change; they don't even acknowledge him.

And my "best friend"? He turned on his own friends. His actions were the total opposite of his words. I was always so impressed by how he talked, I never thought he'd betray me. His words were like music to me, but then they turned into daggers in my heart.

Just give all your worries to God. He can handle them, he'll help you out. He'll never let good people get wrecked. But God, you'll throw those other people into a pit of mud. You'll cut the lives of murderers and traitors in half.
And I trust you.

title: Haters Gonna Hate, God's Got My Back
paragraphs: God, for real, have my back. I'm getting totally wrecked and stepped on every single day. It's like a constant beatdown, and they're relentless. When I'm terrified, I put my trust in you. I'm proud to sing your praises, God. With you, I'm fearless. What can a bunch of nobodies do to me anyway?
They just won't quit. They're trashing my name and scheming to see me fail. They're ganging up, hiding out, just waiting for the perfect moment to jump me. They're so sure they'll get away with it.
God, make it make sense! Get angry and take these people down! Give them what they deserve.
You've seen every single struggle, every sleepless night. You've counted every tear and recorded every bit of pain in your book. That's wild.
So when I call out, my enemies will scatter. That's how I'll know you're on my side, for real.
I'm proud to praise God. I'm fearless now because I trust in God. What can mere mortals even do to me?
God, you kept all your promises, and I'm so grateful. You literally saved me from the edge of disaster, from a total wipeout. Now I'm just chilling, living my best life with you in the light.

title: Hiding From Haters & Trusting God's Plan
paragraphs: God, please be good to me, like, right now! I'm running to you for my life. I'm just gonna hide under your wings 'til this whole storm passes. I'm calling out to the Most High God, the one who's got my back. He'll send help from heaven and save me, and totally own the people who are trying to bring me down. God's love is legit, and He always keeps His promises.
I'm in a really tight spot, surrounded by haters who are just waiting for me to fail. They're talking trash, and their words are like weapons.
Show them how great you are, God! Let your glory cover the whole world!
They set a trap for me, and I almost fell for it. They dug a pit to catch me, but they fell into it themselves. LOL.
I'm ready, God, like, so ready. I'm ready to sing and make some music. Wake up, my soul! Let's get this praise party started!
I'm gonna thank you, God, right out in public. I'll sing your praises everywhere I go. Your love is so huge, it's higher than the sky. Your faithfulness is on display for everyone to see.
Show them how great you are, God! Let your glory cover the whole world!

title: God, Wreck These Guys!
paragraphs: Seriously, is this how you run a country? Like, is there even one honest politician out there? It's all shady deals and secret plots behind the scenes, like they're making deals with demons or something.

These wicked people are messed up from the start. The first words they say are lies. They're like venomous snakes, spitting poison. You can't reason with them or charm them; it's like they've got their ears permanently plugged.

God, just wreck them. Smash their teeth. Make them like tigers with no fangs. Let their lives just fade away like spilled water, leaving nothing but a wet spot. Let them get trampled like grass on a path. Let them melt away like a snail, or be like a baby that never sees the light of day. Before they can even finish their evil plans, God, just toss them in the trash.

When good people see the wicked finally get what's coming to them, they'll be celebrating with their friends. They'll be so happy, it's like they're toasting with the blood of their enemies. Everyone will be cheering, 'See? It pays to do the right thing! God's the one who gives out the rewards and takes care of the world!'

title: When Haters Try to Ambush You
paragraphs: My God! Please, you gotta rescue me from my enemies and defend me from these mutineers who are trying to start drama. Save me from their dirty tricks and protect me from their hit men.

Some real desperadoes have ganged up on me, and they're hiding in ambush, waiting to jump me. I swear, God, I did nothing to deserve this. I haven't crossed anyone or done anyone wrong. But even so, they're still after me, totally determined to take me down.
Wake up and see what's happening! You're God, the God-of-Angel-Armies, Israel's God! It's time to get on the job and deal with these pagans. Don't go easy on these hardcore haters.

They always come back when the sun goes down, howling like a pack of coyotes as they circle the city. Then, out of nowhere, they're all at the gate, snarling insults with daggers drawn in their teeth. They actually think they'll get away with it.

But you, God, you just start laughing. You treat all those godless nations like they're a complete joke. My strong God, I'm just watching you work, because I know I can always count on you. God, in his dependable love, always shows up right on time and lets me see my enemies totally ruined.

Don't just finish them off quickly, God, or my people might forget the lesson. Instead, bring them down in slow motion, taking them apart piece by piece. Let all their arrogant, mean-mouthed talk catch up with them. Expose them and bring them down for every curse they muttered and every lie they told. Finish them off in style! Finish them off for good! Then the whole world will see that God rules in Jacob and that he's in charge everywhere.
They come back when the sun goes down, howling like coyotes as they circle the city. They're like scavengers looking for scraps, and they'll even bite the hand that feeds them.

But me? I'm over here singing about your power and shouting at sunrise about your incredible generosity. You've always been a safe place for me, a good spot to hide when things get rough. My strong God, I'm watching you do your thing, and I know I can always count on you—my God, my dependable love.

title: God, You Ghosted Us?!
paragraphs: Oh God, you've abandoned us. You wrecked our defenses and then just stormed off mad. Please, please come back.
You shook the whole world, like, literally. It's cracking open everywhere. You gotta fix this! Everything is falling apart.

You put us through some seriously tough times, and then just gave us cheap stuff to forget our problems. But then you gave us a sign of hope, something to rally around. So, please, do something, like, right now. Answer us, so the people you love can be saved.

And then God, in all his glory, said, 'I'm so stoked, I'm giving you Shechem as a gift, and I'm handing out Succoth Valley too. Gilead and Manasseh? They're mine. Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my weapon. Moab is just my wash bucket, I'll totally own them. I'll diss Edom and flex on Philistia.'
Who's gonna lead me into the battle? Who's gonna show me the way to Edom? You're not giving up on us, are you, God? You're not gonna ditch our squad, right?
Help us out with this mission, 'cause human help is useless. With God on our side, we'll go all out and crush the enemy for good.

title: My Forever Safe Place
paragraphs: Yo God, for real, listen to my prayer. When I'm feeling totally lost and at my limit, I'm calling out, like, 'Get me to a safe place, ASAP!'

You've always given me space to breathe, a spot to get away from all the drama. It's like I've got a lifetime special access to your safe house, always welcome as your guest. You've always taken me seriously, God, and made me feel right at home with everyone who knows and loves you.

Let the king rule for a super long time, and let it be a good reign. Put his leadership right in your spotlight, God, and have 'Steady Love' and 'Good Faith' be his bodyguards. And I'll be the one writing bangers about how great you are—and I'll actually live out what I sing about every day.

title: Lowkey, God's Got Your Back
paragraphs: God's the only one I'm waiting on, for real. Everything good in my life comes from him, so why would I look anywhere else? He's like the solid ground I can always count on, giving me space to breathe and feel safe. He's my fortress. I'm good for life.

Why are y'all always trying to jump me? Why do you roll with a crew of haters? You've got nothing on me, none of you. You're like a bunch of termites trying to take down a mountain. You talk a big game, but it's all fake. Every time you say 'bless you,' it's a curse.
I'm telling you, God's the only one. I'll wait for his signal. All my hopes are in him. He's my rock, my safe space, my unshakeable castle. I'm set.
My strength and my wins all come from God. He's my rock-solid safe place. So, for real everyone, you can bet your life on him. God's the safest place to be.
People are like smoke, here one minute and gone the next. If you put them all together, it's still nothing. Zero plus zero is still zero.
And if you suddenly get rich, don't get too hyped about it.
God said it once, and I've heard it a million times: 'Real strength comes from God.'
Major love to you, Lord God! You always pay what's fair for a hard day's work.

title: God is My Day One, No Cap
paragraphs: God, You're my God, for real. I'm just so thirsty for You, like I've been trekking through a desert with no Wi-Fi. I just can't get enough.

So I'm here at church, just trying to soak it all in—Your power and Your awesomeness. Your love is insane, it's like I'm actually *living* now. I can't stop talking about how great You are; it just spills out. Every breath I take is to praise You, my hands are up like I'm at a concert for You.

I'm feasting on Your goodness, like the best meal ever, and I can't help but shout out how amazing You are. When I can't sleep at night, I just lie there thinking about how You've always had my back. It makes me feel so safe and free. I'm holding on to You tight, and You're my rock, keeping me steady.

Those haters trying to bring me down? They're basically toast. They're heading for a major L. They'll get what's coming to them, a super violent ending. But the king is chilling, happy in God. All his true friends are celebrating with him, while the petty gossipers finally get silenced for good.

title: When Haters Try to Cancel You
paragraphs: God, for real, you gotta hear me out. I'm basically just whining and whimpering over here, completely convinced it's the end of the world.

Please, don't let them find me—all these haters who are out to get me. They use their words like weapons, just slinging toxic comments like poison-tipped arrows. They attack from the shadows, with no warning, and they don't care who gets caught in the crossfire. They're literally training to be evil, keeping detailed notes on all the traps they've secretly laid out. They're whispering to each other, 'No one can touch us, our crime is perfect.' But the ultimate Detective sees the messed-up secrets they're hiding in their hearts.
Then BAM! God shoots His arrow! And they're all doubled over in pain, falling flat on their faces for everyone to see, while the crowd just smirks.
Everyone sees it. What God did is literally the talk of the town. So be stoked, you good people! Run to God! If you've got a good heart, make praising Him your go-to habit.

title: God's Glow Up is Next Level
paragraphs: Sometimes, the best way to praise you, God who lives in Zion, is just to be quiet and listen. And to actually do what you say. You hear our prayers, even the silent ones.

Eventually, every single one of us shows up at your door feeling super guilty, with all our mistakes weighing us down. It's too much for us to handle, but you just wipe the slate clean, once and for all. It's insane how blessed the people you choose are! Like, being a guest in your house is the most honored experience ever. We're just waiting to get all the good stuff from your place, your heavenly mansion. All the amazing ways you've saved people are like trophies in your room. You're the one who tamed the earth, poured the oceans, made the mountains, and styled the hills. You can quiet a crazy ocean storm or a huge, loud crowd just like that. People from all over will just stop and stare, totally in awe. The sunrise and sunset are basically shouting, 'Come and worship!'

Yo, God, come visit the earth and invite it to a dance party! Make it rain with spring showers and fill up the God-River with life. Make the wheat fields look like they're painted gold. This is what creation was made for! Soak the fields that have been plowed, drench the clumps of dirt with rain, and make everything bloom and grow. Put a crown of snow on the mountains, and throw rose petals all over your paths, even in the wild fields. Make the hills dance, cover the canyon walls with sheep, and lay a blanket of flax across the valleys. Let them all shout and scream and sing their hearts out!

title: God's Glow Up is Real
paragraphs: Alright, everyone, let's give it up for God! Seriously, put your hands together! Let's sing some bangers about how awesome he is, and make his praise go viral. Be like, 'Yo, God is on another level!' When his haters see him work, they just dip like they got caught doing something cringe. The whole world just bows down, worships him, sings to him... they're obsessed with his name and his whole vibe.

Just check out the wild stuff God does—it's mind-blowing. He literally turned the sea into dry land, and people just walked across the river. Like, for real. If that's not a reason to drop a track, I don't know what is.
He's the forever king, watching over all the nations that don't mess with him. Anyone who tries to rebel against him gets shut down.

Yo, everyone, praise our God! Give him a massive shout-out! Didn't he put us on the path to real life? Didn't he save us from totally wrecking ourselves? He put us through the wringer first, like testing silver with fire. He led us through some rough times, pushed us to our absolute limit, tested us in every way possible, and we basically went to hell and back. But in the end, he brought us to a place where we can chill and thrive.

I'm coming to your house with all the best stuff. I'm keeping my promise, the one I made when I was in deep trouble. I'm bringing the best cuts of meat for the offering. Even the smell of the roasted lamb is gonna be epic. Or maybe I'll bring a whole ox with some goat meat on the side!

All you who believe, come and listen up. Let me tell you what God did for me. I cried out to him, and my tongue was already making music to praise him. If I was secretly into bad stuff, the Lord would have never listened. But he totally did listen. He was there for me as soon as I prayed. God is so good. He didn't ignore me. He stuck with me, and his love is the real deal.

title: God's Global Glow Up
paragraphs: God, show us some love and bless us! Give us a smile! Then everyone in the country will see your ways, and all the nations who don't even know you will see how you rescue people.
Yo, God! Let everyone give you a shout-out and just be stoked about you. Seriously, let everyone be thankful.
Let people from all over the world be super happy and shout it out, because you're a totally fair judge. You take care of people everywhere, no matter how far away they are.
God, for real, let everyone thank you and be hyped about you. Let all the people give you props.
Earth, show your wild energy! You bless us, God, our God. You keep on blessing us, God.
Everyone, from every corner of the planet—honor him!

title: God's Victory March is Actually GOATED
paragraphs: Let's go, God! His enemies are toast. They're outta here, running for their lives! They disappear like a puff of smoke, like a blob of wax melting in the fire—one look at God and the wicked just vanish. But when the good guys see God in action, they'll be laughing and singing, just totally stoked.
Sing to God, y'all! Get the hype train going for the one who rides on the clouds. His name is the LORD, so cheer like crazy when you see him!

He's a dad to the fatherless and a defender of widows, that's God for you, right in his holy home. God gives the lonely a family, he breaks prisoners out and leads them to freedom, but he leaves the rebels to dry up in the desert.

Okay, so get this. God, when you led your people out, when you were marching through the wilderness, the earth literally shook and the sky started pouring rain. It was because God was on the move. Even Mount Sinai was trembling when it saw the God of Israel making his entrance. You sent down tons of rain, O God, and the dry, thorny ground turned into a beautiful oasis for your people to live in. You basically took them from zero to hero, from rags to riches.

The Lord gave the command, and a huge crowd of people spread the good news: "The kings and their armies are running away, they're totally retreating!" And the women who stayed home got to divide all the awesome loot, like silver and gold treasures from the Canaanites. The day the Almighty scattered those kings, it was like snow falling on Black Mountain—a fresh start.
Why are you other mountains, you big, beefy mountains of Bashan, so jealous? You can be salty all you want, but this is the mountain God chose to live on. He's going to rule from here forever.

God's chariots are insane—like, tens of thousands of them, and then thousands more. The Lord is leading the charge, coming down from Sinai right into his holy place. You climbed up to the high place, leading a train of captives, with your arms full of gifts you took from the rebels. And now you're sitting there, ruling like a king, O LORD God!

Shoutout to the Lord! Day after day, he carries our burdens. He's our Savior, our God, for real! He's the God who is there for us, the God who saves us. The Sovereign LORD is the one who can even save us from death. And get this, he crushes the heads of his enemies, splitting the skulls of those who keep doing wrong. He said, "I'm gonna bring them back from Bashan, I'll drag them up from the deep sea, so you can walk through your enemies' blood and your dogs can get a taste too." Wild.

Yo, check out God's parade, everyone's seeing it! My God, my King, marching into the sanctuary. The singers are in front, the musicians are behind them, and in the middle are young women playing tambourines. The whole crowd is blessing God. Israel is like a fountain of praise for the LORD. Look! Little Benjamin is leading the way, then the princes of Judah in their fancy robes, and the princes of Zebulun and Naphtali. Show them your power, O God; show them the strength you've used for us. Because of your temple in Jerusalem, kings will bring you gifts. Tell that old crocodile, Egypt, to back off, with its herd of bulls and calves. They're so greedy for money, always starting fights. Let traders from Egypt bring their expensive goods, and let Cush come running to God with hands wide open.

So sing, all you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord! There he is, riding on the ancient skies. Listen! He's speaking, and his voice is like thunder. Tell everyone how awesome God is! His majesty is over Israel, and his power is in the clouds.
You are awesome, O God, coming from your sanctuary. It's the God of Israel who gives strength and power to his people. Bless God, everyone!

title: Help, I'm Drowning & Everyone Hates Me
paragraphs: God, you gotta save me! I'm literally drowning here.
It's like I'm in quicksand and the water's up to my neck. I feel like I'm going under for the last time.
My throat is raw from screaming for help, and my eyes are shot from staring at the sky, looking for you, God.
I have more haters than I can count, for real. They're all liars and snakes, just waiting to stab me in the back.
Now I'm being forced to pay for stuff I never even took. How is that fair?
God, you know all the messed-up things I've done. My life is basically an open book to you.
Please, Lord, God of the armies, don't let the people who trust you get bummed out because of what's happening to me.
God of Israel, please don't let the people looking for you hit a dead end just by watching my life go down in flames.
Because of you, I look like a total fool. I'm so ashamed I can't even show my face.
My own brothers act like they don't know me, like I'm some random dude on the street. My family treats me like a stranger.
I'm just so passionate about you, God. And because I'm so all-in for you, whenever people diss you, I'm the one who gets all the hate for it.
When I tried to get serious with prayer and fasting, people just made fun of me even more.
When I was grieving and looked sad, they treated me like a joke.
Now the town drunks are making up songs about me.
But me? I'm just gonna keep praying. God, I really need a win right now!
God, please answer me with your love! Come through with that solid salvation I know you have!
Get me out of this swamp; don't let me sink for good.
Save me from my enemies; this whole situation is like a whirlpool sucking me down.
Don't let this mess be the end of me. Don't let the darkness swallow me whole and trap me forever.
So please, answer me, God, because you're so loving. Show me your huge mercy, face-to-face.
Don't turn away from me; your boy can't handle it. I'm in deep trouble. Answer me, like, right now!
Come close, God, and get me out of here. Rescue me from this death trap.
You see how they're dragging my name through the mud, making me look like an idiot.
Their insults have completely broken me. I'm on the floor, feeling like a total nobody.
I looked around for just one person who had my back. Not a single one. Couldn't find anyone to lean on.
They might as well have put poison in my food and given me vinegar to drink.
I hope their fancy dinners turn into a trap that snaps shut on them. I hope their best friends betray them.
Let them go blind, and make them so scared they're shaking 24/7.
Show them how you really feel about them. Hit them with your burning anger.
Burn their houses down. Leave their places so empty that no one lives there.
They love to gossip about the person you're already disciplining. They make up stories about anyone who's already hurting.
Just pile on their guilt. Don't let them get away with any of it.
Erase their names from the book of life. Don't let them be remembered with the good people.
I'm hurting and in so much pain. God, lift me up and give me a safe place to heal.
I'm gonna shout out God's name with a song of praise. I'm gonna tell everyone how great he is with a thankful prayer.
For God, that's way better than some animal sacrifice, even a prize-winning bull.
The humble will see this and be so happy. All you who are looking for God, take heart!
Because God actually listens to the poor. He doesn't ignore his people who are locked up and miserable.
Praise him, heavens! Praise him, earth! And the ocean and everything swimming in it!
Because God is coming to save his people and rebuild the broken towns of Judah.
And guess who's gonna live there? The ones who will own the land?
Nah, it's gonna be the kids of his true followers. The ones who love his name will get to live there.

title: When You're Down Bad & Need a Rescue ASAP
paragraphs: God, for real, you gotta hurry and rescue me! God, get to my side, like, ASAP!

All those people trying to ruin my life—let them totally fail and get embarrassed. Everyone who loves seeing me fail—let them get lost and confused. Let them get a taste of their own medicine, all those haters gossiping and shaking their heads at me.
But for everyone looking for you, let them sing and have a blast. Let everyone who loves how you save people keep saying, “God is the GOAT!”
But me? I'm struggling. I'm completely wiped out. God—please, hurry up! Come help me, come rescue me! God, don't waste a single second.

title: God's Got My Back, No Cap
paragraphs: God, I'm running to you for my life, and I know I won't regret it. You're so good at what you do, so get me out of this mess and back on my feet. Please listen to me and give me a safe place to be. Be like a guest room where I can always go, because you said your door is always open. You are my salvation, my huge, strong fortress.

My God, please save me from the hands of wicked people, from the grip of those who are bad and mean. You're the one who keeps me going when things are tough. You've been my rock, God, since I was a kid. I've depended on you since the day I was born, the day you took me from my mother's womb. I will never stop praising you. Many people are shocked when they see me, but you accept me as I am.

Just as every day is full of your beauty, my mouth is full of praise. But please don't get rid of me when I'm old or put me on a shelf when I'm not as strong as I used to be. My enemies are talking about me behind my back, waiting for a chance to hurt me. They're saying, "God has left him. Let's get him now; no one will help him."

God, don't just watch from a distance. Come on! Run to my side! Make my accusers lose face. Make those who want to hurt me look like fools, while I reach out for you and praise you more and more every day. I'll write a book about your righteousness and talk about your salvation all day long, and I'll never run out of good things to write or say. I come in the power of the Lord God, and I'll put up signs to show everyone his way.

You found me when I was just a kid, God, and you taught me everything I know. Now I'm telling the world about your amazing works, and I'll keep doing it until I'm old and gray. God, please don't leave me until I've told this generation about your strong right arm and the next generation about your power. Your righteousness is famous, O God. God, you've done it all! Who is like you? You, who made me face trouble, will turn me around and let me face life again. I've been at the lowest point, but you will bring me up with honors. Turn to me and be gentle with me, and I'll play the lute and thank you for your faithfulness, God. I'll make music for you on the harp, Holy One of Israel. When I sing to you, I'll shout with praise, and my rescued life will be a song. All day long, I'll talk about you and your righteous ways, while those who tried to harm me sneak away in shame.

title: The GOAT King's Prayer
paragraphs: God, give the king your wisdom to rule, and make the prince a just leader. Help him judge your people fairly and be a good dude to the humble and the poor. Let the mountains shout out your justice, and the hills show what it means to live right. Stand up for the poor, save the kids of the needy, and crush anyone who's a tyrant. May he last longer than the sun and the moon, like, forever and ever. Be like rain on a freshly mowed lawn, a total refresh for the earth. Let goodness bloom and peace be everywhere until the moon is gone. Let him rule from sea to sea, from the big river to the ends of the earth.

His enemies will have to bow down to him, and his haters will be eating dust. Kings from faraway, legendary places will bring him gifts, and the super-rich kings will hand over their cash. All the kings will bow down and worship him, and every nation will serve him. That's because he rescues the poor when they cry out, and helps the helpless who have nowhere else to turn. He has a soft spot for the weak and the needy; he saves their lives. He frees them from being bullied and hurt—their lives are precious to him.

Long live the king! May he be showered with the finest gold. Let people pray for him 24/7 and bless him all day long. Let the fields be overflowing with grain, so much that it's like a party on the mountaintops. Let the cities be full of praise, popping up like fresh grass. May his name be famous forever, shining as bright as the sun. May all nations be blessed through him, and may they all give a shout-out to the One who blessed them.
Shout out to the Lord God, the God of Israel, who does amazing things that no one else can. Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and Amen!

title: When Life's Unfair & God Seems AFK
paragraphs: God is good. He's good to people with a good heart. But I almost missed it, I was so close to not seeing His goodness. I was looking at all the wrong things, envying the wicked people who seem to have it all made, without a single worry in the world.

They're so arrogant, their whole vibe is just violence. They're spoiled and overfed, and their ideas are just silly. They mock people, using their words to tear others down; they just bully their way through everything. They're all talk, just loudmouths making a scene. And what's wild is that people actually listen to them, lapping up their every word like they're dying of thirst.

So I'm like, what's the deal? Is God on lunch break? Is anyone even running the show? The wicked get away with everything, they're just stacking up cash and living the good life. I feel like a total idiot for trying to play by the rules. And what did it get me? Just a whole lot of bad luck, like getting slapped in the face every time I step outside.

If I had actually said all this out loud, I would've been a bad influence on your kids. Still, trying to make sense of it all just gave me a massive headache... until I went into God's sanctuary. That's when it all clicked. I saw the whole picture: you've put them on a slippery path that ends in a total crash. In just a second, it's a disaster. A blind turn in the dark, and it's a complete nightmare. Then we wake up and... nothing. They're nothing. They never were.

When I was all stressed and bitter, completely eaten up by envy, I was being so ignorant, like a dumb animal right in front of you. But I'm still here with you, and you've taken my hand. You lead me with wisdom and care, and then you bless me.

You're all I want in heaven! You're all I want on earth! When my body gets old and weak, God is my rock, always faithful. Look! The people who left you are falling apart. They're deserters, and they'll be forgotten. But me? I'm right here with God—and man, it's so refreshing. I've made the Lord my home. God, I'm telling everyone what you do!

title: God, You Ghosted Us?! Where'd You Go?
paragraphs: Like, for real, God, you just up and left us and didn't even look back. How could you do that? We're supposed to be your crew, your sheep. How can you just get mad and dip out?

Yo, remember us? You literally bought us ages ago. We're your special tribe—you paid a lot for us! And Mount Zion? You actually lived here! You gotta come see this disaster. They totally wrecked the sanctuary.

While your people were trying to worship, the enemies just barged in, starting fights and spray-painting graffiti everywhere. They torched the porch, swung axes and chopped up all the cool woodwork. They smashed the doors with sledgehammers and then used the pieces for a bonfire. They burned your holy place to the ground, totally disrespecting the place where we worship you. They were like, 'We're gonna wipe them out,' and then burned down every single place of worship.

There's literally nothing left that points to you, God. No signs, no symbols, nobody to speak for you. No one has a clue what's even happening. How long, God, are these haters gonna get away with dissing you? Are you just gonna let them keep cursing you out? Why aren't you doing anything? You just gonna sit there with your hands in your pockets?

But for real, God is my King, and he's been in charge from the very beginning. He's the one who brings salvation to the whole world. With just one move, you split the sea. You totally wrecked that dragon, Tannin. You chopped off the heads of Leviathan and served them up as a snack for the wild animals. You made springs and creeks with just a touch of your finger, and you dried up massive floods. You own the day and the night; you put the sun and stars in their place. You set up the whole earth, and you made summer and winter.

God, you gotta see this. Remember all the trash the enemy is talking, all the dumb stuff they're doing to disrespect you. Don't just leave us, your flock, to be eaten by wolves. After everything we've been through, don't forget us. Remember what you promised. The city is super dark and the countryside is crazy violent. Don't just leave the victims on the street; turn them into a choir that sings your praises.
Get up, God! Stand up for yourself! Do you hear what they're saying about you? All the nasty things they're saying? Don't ignore their evil words, the constant fighting and insults that never stop.

title: God's the Ultimate Judge, No Cap
paragraphs: We're so grateful, God, seriously. Your name is like, our favorite thing to say. We can't stop talking about all the amazing things you do.

You're like, 'Alright everyone, settle down. I'm here to fix things.' When the world is a total mess and no one knows what's going on, you're the one who holds it all together and puts it back in place. You tell the know-it-alls to chill and the bullies to back off.
Don't even think about messing with God. Don't disrespect the one who's been here forever. He's the one in charge, from everywhere to everywhere.

God is the ultimate judge. He'll humble one person and lift another up. He's got this cup, like a full glass of something strong. He pours it out, and the wicked people on earth have to drink every last drop of it. It's like they have to face the consequences.
So I'm here to tell everyone about the eternal God, to sing about how great the God of Jacob is. The wicked are powerless, but the good people are thriving.

title: God's Ultimate Flex
paragraphs: Yo, God's a big deal in Judah, like, everyone in Israel knows who He is. He's got a place in Salem, a whole setup in Zion. That's where He literally made a bonfire out of war weapons, using arrows as firewood. Wild.

You're shining so bright, way brighter than all the stuff they stole. Those tough warriors? They got wrecked and left with nothing. All their big talk and threats mean zero now. When you roared, God of Jacob, it was game over for them and their horses.

you're fierce. Who could possibly stand against you when you're angry? You drop justice like thunder from the sky, and the whole world just goes silent and kneels. God steps up, fixes things, and saves everyone who's struggling. All that anger people had? It just turns into praise for God. Their pointless rage is now like a trophy for Him.
So, keep your promises to God. He's your God, after all. Everyone should bring their gifts to the One who sees everything we do. You can't get away with anything; you can't mess with Him.

title: God, You Ghosting Me or What?
paragraphs: I'm screaming out to God, like, with everything I've got. Just yelling my lungs out. And He's listening.

I was in deep trouble, so I went searching for my Lord. My life felt like this wound that just wouldn't close up. And when my friends were like, 'It's all gonna be okay,' I just couldn't buy it. I think about God and just... shake my head. I'm so down, just twisting my hands. Can't sleep at all, like, not even for a second. I can't even put into words what's messing with me. I'm just replaying all the past days and years in my head. Playing my guitar all night, just trying to figure out how to get my life on track.

Is the Lord just gonna walk out on us for good? Is He never gonna smile at us again? Is His love, like, totally worn out? Has His promise to save us just expired? Did God forget how to be kind? Did He just get mad and storm off? I was like, 'Wow, just my luck. The moment I need Him most, the Most High God decides to retire.'

Okay, I'm gonna go over everything God has done again. I'll lay out all the amazing things He did way back when. I'm gonna think hard about all the stuff You've done, and just take a long, appreciative look at Your work.

Oh God! Your way is holy. No god is as great as our God! You're the God who makes impossible things happen; You showed everyone what You're capable of— You rescued Your people from the absolute worst situations, saved the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.

The ocean saw You in action, God, and it totally freaked out; the deep sea was scared to death. The clouds poured down rain like crazy, the sky exploded with thunder, and Your lightning was flashing everywhere. Your thundering voice came out of a whirlwind, lightning lit up the whole world, and the Earth was shaking and rocking. You walked right through the ocean, straight through the roaring sea, but nobody saw Your footprints.
You led Your people like a flock of sheep, and Moses and Aaron were the shepherds You used to do it.

title: Israel's Epic Fail History & God's Crazy Patience
paragraphs: Yo, listen up, my friends, to God's truth. For real, pay attention to what I'm about to say. I'm about to drop some wisdom, some ancient secrets, stories we heard from our parents and their parents before them. We're not gatekeeping this stuff; we're passing it on to you guys—the stories of God's awesome power and the incredible things he's done.

He made a promise to Jacob's crew and gave his laws to Israel. He told our ancestors to teach them to their kids so the next generation would know, and all the generations after that. They'd know the truth, tell the stories, and learn to trust in God. They'd remember his works and actually follow his rules. Seriously, let's not be like our ancestors—they were stubborn, rebellious, and their hearts weren't in it. They were a flaky bunch who couldn't stay loyal to God.

The Ephraimites, all geared up for a fight, totally bailed when the battle started. They broke God's covenant and refused to live by his word. They forgot all the amazing things he'd done, the miracles he performed right in front of them. He did wild things for their parents in Egypt, in the fields of Zoan. He split the sea, and they walked right through it, with the water piled up like walls on either side. He led them with a cloud during the day and a fiery torch at night. He split rocks in the desert and gave them water from underground springs. He made streams flow from solid rock, like a river of water out of nowhere.

But what did they do? They just kept sinning, rebelling against the Most High God in the desert. They tested God, demanding their favorite foods. They were like, 'Can God even spread a table in the wilderness? Sure, he hit a rock and water came out, but can he give us bread? Can he give us meat?'

When God heard this, he was so mad. His anger flared up against Jacob and Israel because they didn't believe in him or trust that he would save them. But he still helped them. He commanded the clouds, opened the doors of heaven, and rained down manna for them to eat. He gave them the bread of heaven. They ate the food of angels; he sent them more than enough. He unleashed the east wind and brought in the south wind. He rained down birds on them, so many birds. They landed right in the middle of their camp, all around their tents. They ate until they were stuffed. He gave them exactly what they were craving. But they were still greedy, stuffing their faces. Finally, God had enough. His anger exploded, and he struck down their strongest and best young men.

And can you believe it? They kept on sinning. After all those miracles, they still didn't believe. So their lives just faded away, leaving nothing behind. When God struck them down, they'd come running back, asking for mercy. They'd say that God was their rock, their savior. But they were just saying it; they were lying the whole time. They didn't actually care about him or his covenant.

And God? He was so compassionate. He forgave their sin and didn't destroy them. He held back his anger so many times. He knew they were only human, just a passing breeze. They were always testing him in the desert, grieving him in the wilderness. They kept pushing his buttons, provoking the Holy One of Israel. They forgot his power, the day he rescued them from their enemies, the miracles he did in Egypt, the wonders in Zoan. He turned their rivers to blood, so they couldn't drink. He sent swarms of flies that ate them and frogs that drove them nuts. He gave their crops to caterpillars and their harvest to locusts. He destroyed their vines with hail and their trees with frost. He killed their cattle with hail and their livestock with lightning. He unleashed his burning anger on them, a band of destroying angels. He didn't hold back; he let the plague kill them. He struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, the firstfruits of their strength. Then he led his people out like sheep, guiding them safely through the wilderness. He took care of them, and they weren't afraid. The sea drowned their enemies. He brought them to his holy land, the mountain he won for himself. He drove out the nations before them, gave them their land as an inheritance, and settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.

But they kept testing him, rebelling against the Most High God and not keeping his laws. They were even worse than their ancestors, as unreliable as a crooked bow. They made God angry with their high places and jealous with their idols. When God heard about it, he was furious and completely rejected Israel. He abandoned his dwelling at Shiloh, the tent where he lived among people. He let the ark of his strength be captured, his glory taken by the enemy. He handed his people over to be killed by the sword, furious with his own inheritance. Fire consumed their young men, and their young women had no one to marry. Their priests were killed, and their widows couldn't even cry.

Then the Lord woke up, like he was waking from a deep sleep, like a warrior shouting after drinking wine. He struck his enemies from behind and put them to shame forever. He rejected Joseph and didn't choose Ephraim. Instead, he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved. He built his sanctuary like the high heavens, like the earth, which he established forever. He chose his servant David, taking him from the sheep pens. He took him from caring for sheep and lambs to be the shepherd of his people Jacob, his inheritance Israel. And David shepherded them with a good heart and led them with skillful hands.

title: God, Our City is WRECKED... You Gonna Do Something?
paragraphs: God, for real? Some thugs just rolled into Your place, totally trashed Your holy temple, and left Jerusalem looking like a disaster zone. They fed Your faithful followers to the birds and left their bodies out for wild animals to snack on. They spilled their blood all over Jerusalem like it was nothing, and didn't even bother to bury them. Now, our neighbors are laughing at us, treating us like a total joke.

How long is this gonna last, God? Are You gonna be mad at us forever? Is Your anger ever going to chill? If You're gonna be mad, be mad at the people who don't even know You, the other kingdoms that ignore You. They're the ones who messed up Jacob's crew and wrecked their homes.

Don't punish us for our ancestors' screw-ups. Hurry up and help us out; we're seriously at our limit. You're known for being a helper, God, so give us a break. Your whole reputation is on the line here. Get us out of this mess and forgive our sins—do what You're famous for! Don't let these other nations get away with saying, 'LOL, where's their God now?' Show them all, right now, that they can't just take out Your people and get away with it.

Listen to the prisoners who are hurting. You have the power to save those who are about to be executed, so do it! And as for our neighbors who've been mocking us, give them a taste of their own medicine. Let their insults come right back and hit them hard. Then we, Your people, the flock You take care of, will thank You forever and ever. We'll tell everyone we meet how awesome and praiseworthy You are!

title: God, Are You Ghosting Us?!
paragraphs: Yo, Shepherd of Israel, listen up! You gotta get your crew—all of Joseph's descendants—together. Shine a massive spotlight from your awesome throne so Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh can see the path. Seriously, wake up! You've been hitting the snooze button for way too long. We need you, like, yesterday!
God, for real, come back to us. Just flash us one of those blessed smiles, and we'll be saved. That's all it takes.

God, the Commander of Heaven's armies, how long are you gonna stay mad? It feels like you're a volcano just about to blow, while we're out here praying our hearts out. You've got us on a straight-up tear diet, and we're drinking buckets of this salty stuff. All our neighbors are laughing at us, and our enemies are roasting us 24/7.
God of the Angel Armies, please come back! If you just smile at us with your blessing, that's our salvation.

Don't you remember how you brought us out of Egypt like a baby vine? You cleared out all the junk to plant your own special vineyard. You prepped the soil and planted us deep, and we totally took over the land. Our vine grew so huge it threw shade on mountains and made giant cedars look small. We stretched from the sea to the river. So, what's the deal? Why'd you stop protecting us? Randoms are just walking in and stealing our grapes. Wild hogs are wrecking the place, and even mice are getting in on the action. God of the Angel Armies, look over here! Check out what's happened to your vine. You gotta take care of what you planted and grew yourself. And the people who tried to burn it all down? Give them the death stare. Then, hold the hand of your favorite kid, the one you raised. We promise we won't turn away from you again; just give us a new life so we can shout out your name!
God, Commander of the Angel Armies, come back to us! Smile that blessing-smile, and that'll be our salvation.

title: God's Dropping Truth Bombs, You Listening?
paragraphs: Let's get loud for our awesome God! A huge shoutout to the God of Jacob! Let's hear it from the choir, the band's kicking in with the lute and harp, and the brass section is going all out with trumpets and trombones. It's a full-on festival, a party for God!
God himself put this on the calendar, a day the God of Jacob said we gotta celebrate. He told Joseph to make sure we never forget the crazy stuff He pulled off for us in Egypt.
Then, out of nowhere, I hear this super quiet whisper from someone I never thought would talk to me:

‘I literally took a huge weight off your shoulders, you can stop grinding 24/7 now. You hit me up when you were hurting, and I pulled you out of that mess. I came through for you from the storm, and I showed you what was up at Meribah Fountain.'

‘Alright, listen up, everyone—for real, get this straight. Israel, this is no joke. Don't get distracted by other gods, don't just follow what's popular. I'm *your* God, the one who saved you from total disaster in Egypt, and then made sure you had more than enough to eat, I filled you up.'
‘But my people just weren't listening, Israel straight up ignored me. So I was like, 'Fine, have it your way. Go do your own thing.'

‘So, for real, are you gonna listen to me now? Israel, are you gonna follow my lead? I'll take care of your enemies real quick, they won't know what hit 'em. All the haters will be whimpering away, and you'll never hear from them again. You'll be feasting on the good stuff, like fresh bread with butter and the purest honey.'

title: God Puts the Judges on Blast
paragraphs: God’s basically calling all the judges into His courtroom and putting them on trial. He’s like, “Alright, that’s enough. You’ve been bending the rules of justice for way too long. You’ve let guilty people walk free from the most serious crimes. Your whole job is to stick up for those who can’t defend themselves, to make sure the underdogs get a fair shot. You’re supposed to be a voice for the powerless and bring down the hammer on anyone who tries to exploit them.”

But these judges are clueless. They’re like those people who just ignore all the problems, with their heads buried in the sand. They have no idea what’s really going on. And because of them, everything is starting to fall apart. The world is coming unglued.

God says, “I’m the one who appointed you as judges. Every single one of you. You were supposed to be my representatives, deputies of the Most High. But you completely betrayed your mission. So now, you’re stripped of your rank. You’re busted.”
So, the prayer is like, “O God, please give these corrupt judges what they deserve! You’re in control of the whole world, after all!”

title: God, All My Haters Are Ganging Up On Me!
paragraphs: God, seriously, don't ignore me. Don't give me the silent treatment. Your haters are out there throwing a party, living it up. They're scheming to take down your people, conspiring to mess with the ones you treasure. They're literally saying, "Let's wipe this nation off the map, scrub Israel's name from history."

And now they're all in on it together, making plans to take you down. We're talking Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites, Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, Philistia and the Tyrians. And to top it off, Assyria just joined their crew, adding muscle to Lot's descendants.

So, do to them what you did to Midian, and to Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Brook. They met a gnarly end at Endor, basically becoming fertilizer for the fields. Take out their leaders just like you did with Oreb and Zeeb, and their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna. All they did was brag, "We're gonna take it all, we're grabbing God's own gardens for ourselves."

My God, I'm so over them! Just blow them away like tumbleweeds in the wind, like burnt sticks in a wildfire. Knock the wind out of them so they're gasping your name, "God." Bring them to their breaking point and just leave them there, totally helpless. Then they'll finally get it. They'll learn your name: "God," the one and only, the Most High over all the earth.

title: Why God's House is the Ultimate Hangout Spot
paragraphs: Yo God, Your house is legit beautiful! I've always been dreaming of a room in Your place, where I could just sing my heart out to the living God.

Even the birds find little spots in Your house. Sparrows and swallows build nests there, lay their eggs, and raise their babies, just singing away where we worship. God of Angel Armies, my King, my God! They're so blessed to live and sing there.

And you know who else is blessed? Anyone who has You in their life. Their lives become like a road trip with You. They'll be walking through a super boring valley, and then boom, they find a creek, cool springs, and pools filled with rain! When God's your travel buddy, the road just keeps getting better, and then you're at the top, at Zion, seeing God in person!
God of Angel Armies, please listen up. God of Jacob, hear me out—I'm praying! Look at us, all geared up and shining, our faces glowing because You've got our backs.

Honestly, one day in Your house, this amazing place of worship, is better than thousands of days on some fancy beach vacation. I'd rather be the janitor in my God's house than be the guest of honor in a palace full of fakes. God is all sunshine and is the ultimate King, super generous with gifts and glory. He never holds back on His friends. It's smooth sailing all the way when you're with the God of Angel Armies.

title: God's Epic Comeback & The Ultimate Glow-Up
paragraphs: God, you were totally cool with our country and brought back the good times for Jacob's family. You forgave everyone and wiped our slates clean, basically pretending our sins never even happened. You stopped being angry with us and totally chilled out.

So, God our Savior, please get us back on track and don't be mad at us forever. You're not gonna stay angry for years and years, are you? Why not give us a fresh start, a whole new life? Then we, your people, can be happy and celebrate you. Show us your love, God, and save us like you promised!

I'm waiting to hear what God has to say. He's gonna speak peace to his people, the ones who are loyal to him, so they don't go back to their old, foolish ways. For real, his salvation is super close for those who respect him, and his glory is gonna make our country its home.

Love and faithfulness are gonna meet up; righteousness and peace are gonna hug it out. Truth is gonna sprout up from the ground, and righteousness will look down from the sky. Yeah! God is gonna give us what's good, and our land will produce a huge harvest. Righteousness will go ahead of him and clear a path for his steps.

title: God, My Ride or Die
paragraphs: God, please listen up and answer me. I'm seriously going through it right now! Keep me safe—you know I've been trying to live right. Help me out, I'm literally all in on you. You're my God, so please show me some love. I'm hitting you up from morning to night. Make me happy again; I'm trusting you with everything. Everyone knows you're good and forgiving, super generous to anyone who asks for help. So please, God, pay attention to my prayer; listen to my desperate cries. Whenever I'm in trouble, I call you, 'cause I know you'll come through.

There's legit no one like you among all the so-called gods, Lord. Nothing even comes close to what you do. All the nations you created are coming to worship you, Lord, to hype you up and show off how amazing you are. You're the one who does incredible things—God, you're the only one, for real.

Teach me how to live right, God, and I'll stick to your path. Help me focus all my energy on you, so I can worship you with my whole heart, no distractions. I thank you from the bottom of my heart, dear Lord; I'm always telling people how great you are. You've been so good to me—it's crazy love! You literally saved me from hitting rock bottom. God, these haters are coming for me. A whole squad of them is trying to take me down, and they couldn't care less about you. But you, O God, are so gentle and kind, you don't get mad easily, your love is massive, and you never give up. So please, look at me and be kind, give me the strength to keep going, and save your kid! Show everyone how much you love me, so the haters will be shook and speechless when you, God, gently and powerfully get me back on my feet.

title: Zion: God's Favorite City is Lowkey Famous
paragraphs: God built his city, Zion, on the holy mountain, and He loves it. He loves it way more than all the other places in Jacob combined. It's literally God's hometown, and yo, everyone's talking about you, Zion!

I'm calling out all the places where I'm famous: Egypt and Babylon, Philistia, even Tyre, and Cush too. The word is spreading, and people are pointing them out like, "Yo, that one was born again here!"
The hype about Zion is getting out there: guys and girls, left and right, are getting a fresh start, being born again in her.
God's literally keeping a list, writing down their names in his book: "This one, that one, and this one too—all born again, right here."
All the singers and dancers are giving a huge shout-out to Zion, saying, "All my creative juices, all my good vibes, they all come from you!"

title: God, Are You Ghosting Me?
paragraphs: God, for real, you're my last shot. I'm literally on my knees all night praying to you. Please, just put me on your 'to-save' list; you gotta see the mess I'm in. I've had enough trouble to last a lifetime; I'm basically knocking on hell's door. Everyone's written me off as a lost cause, just another statistic, a total hopeless case. I'm abandoned like I'm already dead, just another body in a pile of corpses, without even a gravestone to my name—I'm like a black hole, totally forgotten. You've thrown me into the deepest pit, sunk me in a pitch-black abyss. Your anger is crushing me, and I'm getting slammed by your waves of rage over and over. You made my own friends turn on me, made them think I'm disgusting. I'm trapped in this maze and can't find a way out, my eyes are so swollen from crying in pain and frustration.

I'm calling out to you, God; I call you all day long. I'm wringing my hands, begging for you to help. Do dead people get to see your miracles? Do ghosts get up and join the choir to praise you? Does your love even matter in a cemetery? Does anyone notice your faithfulness in the hallways of hell? Are your amazing wonders ever seen in the dark? Does anyone see your righteousness in the Land of No Memory?

I'm holding my ground, God, screaming for help, praying every single morning, on my knees at sunrise. But God, why are you ignoring me? Why are you making yourself so scarce? I've been hurting for as long as I can remember; I've taken the worst you can dish out, and I'm so done. Your fiery anger has torched my whole life; I'm bleeding, black and blue. You've attacked me from every angle, raining down hits until I'm almost dead. You made the people I love turn away from me; the only friend I have left is the darkness.

title: God's Unbreakable Promise... Or Is It? 😬
paragraphs: God, your love is my ultimate jam, and I'll sing about it forever! I'm always telling everyone how faithful you are. I'll never get tired of sharing the story of your love—how you built the entire universe and made sure everything in it was solid. Your love has always been the foundation of our lives, and your faithfulness has been the roof over our world. You once said, "I've teamed up with my chosen leader, I gave my word to my servant, David, saying, 'Everyone who comes from you is guaranteed a future; I'll make your rule as solid and lasting as a rock.'"

Yo, God! Let the whole universe praise your amazing ways, and let the choir of holy angels sing about how you always keep your promises! Look high, look low, search the skies and the earth, you won't find anyone or anything quite like God. The holy angels are totally in awe of him; he's so immense and majestic to everyone around him. God of the Angel Armies, who is like you? You're powerful and faithful from every single angle. You put the arrogant ocean in its place and chill out its waves when they get wild. You completely owned that old hag Egypt, you brushed off your enemies with a flick of your wrist. You own the cosmos—you made everything in it, from the tiniest atom to the mightiest archangel. You set up the North and South Poles; mountains like Tabor and Hermon are basically singing duets to you. With your super-strong arm and your iron grip—nobody messes with you! What's Right and Just are the roots of your kingdom; Love and Truth are the fruit. Blessed are the people who know the cheat codes to praising you, who get to march in the bright light of your presence. They're so stoked, they dance all day long; they know who you are and what you do—they can't keep it a secret! Your awesome vibe has gotten into us—you've been so good to us! We're walking on air! Everything we are and everything we have, we owe to God, the Holy God of Israel, our King!

A long time ago, you spoke in a vision to your faithful and beloved friend: "I've crowned a hero, I chose the best person I could find; I found David, my servant, and poured holy oil on his head. And I'll keep my hand on him, for sure, I'll stick with him through thick and thin. No enemy will get the best of him, no scoundrel will ever do him in. I'll get rid of everyone who opposes him, I'll clear out everyone who hates him. I'm with him for good and I'll love him forever; I've put him on a pedestal—he's riding high! I've put the Ocean in one of his hands, and the River in the other; he'll call out to me, 'Oh, my Father—my God, my Rock of Salvation!' Yes, I'm setting him apart as the first in the royal line, the High King over all the kings of the earth. I'll keep him forever in my love, I'll faithfully do everything I so seriously promised. I'll guarantee his family line and I'll back up his rule. If his kids refuse to do what I say, if they refuse to walk the path I show them, if they diss the directions I give them and tear up the rules I post—I'll rub their faces in the dirt of their rebellion and make them face the consequences. But I'll never throw them out, never abandon or disown them. Do you really think I'd take back my holy promise? Or go back on words I've already said? I've given my word, my whole and holy word; do you think I would lie to David? His family line is here for good, his kingdom is as sure as the sun, as dependable as the phases of the moon, as inescapable as the weather."

But God, you actually did walk off and leave us. You lost your temper with the king you chose. You tore up the promise you made to your servant, you stomped his crown right into the mud. You blew up his home, reduced his city to a pile of rubble. Now he's getting robbed by strangers passing by, and he's a joke to all his neighbors. You threw a party for all his enemies, and they're celebrating like crazy. You got angry and turned against him in battle, you refused to fight on his side. You took away his shine, humiliated this warrior, and ground his royal honor into the dirt. You stole the best years of his life and left him as a weak, ruined mess. How long do we have to put up with this, God? Are you gone for good? Are you going to hold this grudge forever? Remember how sad I am and how short life is. Did you create people for nothing but this? We're all going to die soon enough. Everyone does. And there's no escape hatch out of the grave. So where is that love you're so famous for, Lord? What happened to the promise you made to David? Take a good look at your servant, dear Lord; I'm the butt of jokes from every nation, the taunting jokes of your enemies, God, as they follow every step of your chosen king.
Blessed be God forever and always! Yes. Oh, yes.

title: God, Are We Ever Gonna Catch a Break?
paragraphs: God, you've basically been our home forever. Like, way before the mountains were even a thing, before you even created the earth, from the beginning of time to the end, you are God.

So don't just send us back to being dust, telling us to go back to where we came from. Have some patience! You have all the time in the world—a thousand years or just one day, it's all the same to you. Are we just like a quick dream to you, or like grass that looks amazing when the sun comes up but then gets cut down without anyone thinking twice? Your anger is seriously overwhelming; we're at our breaking point. You keep a record of all our mistakes; every wrong thing we've done since we were kids is written down. All we can ever seem to remember is you being disappointed in us. Is this all we're ever going to get? We live for about seventy years, maybe eighty if we're lucky, and what do we get out of it? Problems. Hard work and problems and then a tombstone. Who can even understand this level of anger, this rage against the very people who are in awe of you?

Oh! Teach us how to live a good life! Teach us to live with wisdom and purpose. Come back to us, God—how much longer do we have to wait? Please, be kind to your people for once. Surprise us with your love when we wake up; then we'll be happy and joyful all day long. Give us some good times to make up for all the bad times; we've seen enough bad things to last us forever. Let us, your servants, see the awesome things you can do—the ways you lead and bless your people. And let the beauty of our Lord, our God, be on us, and make the work we do successful. Oh, yes. Please make our work successful!

title: God's Got Your Back, No Cap
paragraphs: Yo, if you're chilling in the presence of the Most High God, basically having a sleepover in the shadow of the Almighty, you can straight up say this: 'God, you're my safe space. I trust you completely, so I know I'm secure.'

And that's a fact. He'll rescue you from hidden traps and shield you from deadly stuff. His huge, outstretched arms will protect you—under them, you're totally safe; His arms block all harm. Don't be scared of anything—not wild animals in the night, not attacks in broad daylight, not sickness that sneaks around in the dark, and not disasters that happen at noon. Even if thousands of people are falling all around you, you won't get a single scratch. You'll just stand there, untouched, and watch from a distance as the wicked get what they deserve. Yeah, because God is your refuge, the High God is your home, so evil can't get close to you, and harm can't even get through the door. He's ordered His angels to guard you wherever you go. If you stumble, they'll catch you; their job is to keep you from falling. You'll walk right over lions and snakes, and kick young lions and serpents out of your way.

God says, 'If you hold on to me for dear life, I'll get you out of any trouble. I'll take the best care of you if you just get to know and trust me. Call me and I'll answer. I'll be right there with you in tough times. I'll rescue you and then we'll celebrate. I'll give you a long life and a big drink of salvation!'

title: Why Giving Thanks is a Vibe
paragraphs: What a beautiful thing, God, to give thanks, to sing an anthem to you, the High God! To announce your love each daybreak, sing your faithful presence all through the night, Accompanied by dulcimer and harp, the full-bodied music of strings.

You made me so happy, God. I saw your work and I shouted for joy. How magnificent your work, God! How profound your thoughts! Dullards never notice what you do; fools never do get it. When the wicked popped up like weeds and all the evil men and women took over, You mowed them down, finished them off once and for all. You, God, are High and Eternal. Look at your enemies, God! Look at your enemies—ruined! Scattered to the winds, all those hirelings of evil!

But you’ve made me strong as a charging bison, you’ve honored me with a festive parade. The sight of my critics going down is still fresh, the rout of my malicious detractors. My ears are filled with the sounds of promise: “Good people will prosper like palm trees, Grow tall like Lebanon cedars; transplanted to God’s courtyard, They’ll grow tall in the presence of God, lithe and green, virile still in old age.”
Such witnesses to upright God! My Mountain, my huge, holy Mountain!

title: God's Reign is No Joke
paragraphs: God is the ultimate King, robed and ready to rule. He's not just robed; He's surging with unstoppable strength.
And yeah, the world is solid, not going anywhere. Your throne has always been firm because You're eternal. You've been here forever!
The oceans are going wild, God! The sea storms are roaring, and the waves are crashing down like thunder.
But You, God, are stronger than any wild sea storm, mightier than the loudest thunderous breakers. From Your place in high heaven, You rule over all of it.
What You say goes, and it always has. Your palace, Your rule—it's all marked by beauty and holiness, and that's for all time, forever and ever.

title: God, Drop the Ban Hammer on These Bullies!
paragraphs: God, for real, shut down all this evil. It's time to show them what you're about. You're the judge of the whole world, so step up and give those arrogant people what they deserve.
God, how long are you gonna let these wicked people get away with literally everything? They're out here bragging about all the messed-up stuff they do.

They're treating your people like doormats, God, just using and abusing them. They'll get rid of anyone who stands in their way. And they have the nerve to think you're not even watching, like you've clocked out for lunch or something.

Seriously? You guys are such idiots. When are you going to get a clue? You think the one who made ears can't hear? The one who made eyes can't see? You think the one who coaches nations doesn't know how to discipline, or that the teacher of all humanity doesn't know what's up? God sees right through you. He knows how dumb your plans are and how shallow you are..

It's a major glow-up for the person you teach, God. You give them your playbook, and it's like a chill zone in the middle of all the chaos, while the bad guys are basically getting their jail cell ready. God's not gonna abandon his people. He'll never ignore them. Justice is coming, for real, and things are gonna be made right for everyone who's been trying to do good.

Who had my back against all the haters and bullies? Who was on my team? Honestly, if God hadn't been there, I would've been toast. The second I felt like I was about to lose it, like 'I'm slipping!', your love caught me, God. When I was totally freaking out, you were the one who calmed me down and made me feel okay again.

Do you really think corrupt leaders can be on your team? Can the guys who cause trouble pretend they're your friends? They ganged up on good people and schemed against the innocent. But God was my safe space, my ultimate fortress. And then, plot twist, he flipped their evil plans right back on them. He wiped them out because of their own wickedness. Our God totally cleaned house.

title: God's On Another Level, Don't Test Him
paragraphs: Yo, let's get hyped and scream praises to God! Let's make some noise for the Rock who's got our backs!
Let's roll up to him with thank-you songs and just blast our hymns like we're at a concert.

And here's the tea: it's because God is the GOAT, the High King over any other so-called gods. He's got the whole world in His hands—from the deepest caves to the highest mountains. He literally made the ocean; He owns it! His own hands sculpted the whole Earth!
So for real, let's worship Him. Bow down, get on your knees before God, the one who made us! Yup, He's our God, and we're the squad He looks after, the flock He feeds.

So drop everything and listen up, for real, listen to what He's saying: “Don’t be stubborn and tune me out like your ancestors did back at Meribah, that day they tested me in the desert. For forty years, they saw all the crazy stuff I did for them, but they still kept trying my patience. And I was so over it—like, seriously provoked! I was like, ‘Can they not think about God for even five minutes? Are they just allergic to following my path?’ I was so fed up I just blew up, ‘Fine, they’re never gonna get to where they’re going. They’ll never find that place of rest.’”

title: God's Victory Tour is GOATED
paragraphs: Hey, sing a brand-new song for God! The whole world, every single person, sing out! Sing to God—give Him the props He deserves!
Spread the news of His win from coast to coast. Tell the people who are lost about His glory, and share His amazing stories with everyone!
For real, God is so great, He deserves like, a thousand Hallelujahs. His power and beauty are so intense it makes other gods look like a joke. Seriously, those pagan gods are nothing, just fakes.
God made the heavens—He's got this kingly glow, and His powerful beauty is just on another level.
Let's go, God, let's go! Everyone, get loud and shout: Encore! We're just in awe of His beauty and His power.
Bring gifts and let's celebrate! Bow down to God's amazingness, and then everyone, get on your knees and worship!
Get the message out—God is in charge! He made the world super stable, and He's always fair to everyone.
Let's hear it from the sky, with the earth joining in, and a huge round of applause from the sea.
Let the wild places do cartwheels, all the animals come and dance, and every tree in the forest can join the choir—
A massive party for God as He comes, as He comes to make everything right on Earth, to fix everything and be fair to everyone.

title: God's Reign is Next Level
paragraphs: God is in charge, and that's a reason to get hyped! Seriously, everyone, everywhere—let's celebrate!
Bright clouds and storm clouds are all around him; his rule is built on what's right and fair.
Fire blazes out in front of him, and it burns up all his enemies around him.
His lightning lights up the whole world; the earth sees it and is totally shaken.
The mountains just melt like wax when they see the Lord, the Lord of the whole earth.
The heavens are telling everyone that he's righteous, and all the people see his glory. It's gonna be epic!
All the people who worship idols are gonna be so embarrassed—they were so proud of their worthless gods!
All you so-called gods, get on your knees and worship him! Zion, listen up and be glad!
All you towns of Judah, be happy, because God has made everything right.
You, God, are the Most High over all the earth; you're way higher than all the other gods.
If you love God, you have to hate evil. He protects the lives of his faithful followers and saves them from the wicked.
Light is shining on the righteous, and joy is for those who do what's right.
So, all you who are right with God, be happy in the Lord and praise his holy name!

title: The World's Biggest Encore
paragraphs: Yo, let's drop a fresh new track for God, because He's done some seriously wild things!
He literally just rolled up His sleeves and made everything right..
God showed the whole world His salvation, like a massive global reveal of what He can do.
He didn't forget to show love to His fam, Israel. That's some ride-or-die love right there.
The entire planet needs to pay attention. Look! God's salvation is happening right now!
So, everyone, let's get loud for God! Just let it all out and sing! Let's get the music going!
We need a whole orchestra for God, and maybe a 100-person choir to back it up.
Bring out the trumpets and the big trombones. Let's fill the air with praise for the King.
Let the ocean and all the fish in it give a huge round of applause, and everyone and everything on earth should join in.
Let the waves be like, 'Encore!' and the mountains can sing the harmony for the big finish.
It's all a huge tribute to God for when He comes to fix the world.
He's going to sort everything out, for real. The whole world and every single person in it will be made right.

title: God's Holy, That's the Vibe
paragraphs: God is in charge, for real. So, everyone, pay attention! He's ruling from his throne with angels all around—you better believe it. God is a huge deal in Zion; he's way more awesome than any celebrity. Your power and awesomeness are insane, God. Everyone should be praising you! You're holy. Seriously, so holy.

Strong King, who's all about justice. You made everything fair and right from the start. You set up the rules for Jacob, and they're all about being just and doing the right thing. So, give it up for God, our God. Worship him because he's in control! He's holy. Yeah, holy.

Moses and Aaron were his priests, and Samuel was one of the guys who always prayed to him. They'd pray, and God would actually answer. He even talked to them from a huge cloud pillar. And they listened; they followed his rules and the laws he gave them. And then God, our God, answered them (but he wasn't a pushover when they messed up). So, lift up God, our God, and worship him at his holy mountain. Because God, our God, is holy. For real.
