title: The Ultimate Hype Song for God
paragraphs: On your feet, everyone—give God a massive round of applause! Show up with a huge smile, and sing your way right to him.
For real, you gotta know that God is God. He's the one who made us; we didn't just make ourselves. We're his people, the flock he takes amazing care of.
Walk in with the password: 'Thank you!' Make yourself at home, just start praising him. Thank him. Worship him.
Because God is just pure goodness, his love is crazy generous, and he's loyal forever and always.

title: How to Live a Legendary Life
paragraphs: My whole vibe is about God's love and justice, and this song's for you, God. I'm trying to live right, but for real, when are you gonna pull up? I'm giving it my all, especially at home where it really matters.

I'm not even gonna look twice at sketchy people or messed-up stuff. All those fake gods? Hard pass. I'm keeping my life clean. People with shady hearts can stay away; I'm not messing with anyone who's plotting bad stuff. I'll straight up mute anyone who trash-talks their neighbor; I just can't with that arrogant energy.

But I'm always looking for the real ones, the salt-of-the-earth people—they're the ones I want on my team. The guys and girls who are on the straight and narrow, those are the ones I want by my side. But if you're all about lies, you're not getting a job with me; I have zero patience for liars. I've rounded up all the wicked people and kicked them out of the country. I'm cleaning up God's city from everyone who makes a business out of doing evil.

title: When Life Hits Rock Bottom, God's Still Got You
paragraphs: God, for real, listen up! Hear my prayer, man. I'm hurting and I'm screaming for you. Don't ignore me right when I need you the most. Pay attention! This is a legit SOS, and I need you, like, right now!

I'm basically turning into nothing. I'm burning up, it feels like I have a major fever. I'm a shadow of who I used to be, like I'm already halfway gone with some terminal thing. My jaw hurts from clenching my teeth so hard, and I'm just skin and bones. I'm like some lonely vulture in the desert, or a crow just sitting on a pile of rocks. I can't sleep, I'm just up all night, sad like a little bird in the gutter. My enemies are dissing me all day long, and other people just curse me out. It's like I'm eating ashes for dinner and my drink is just a bucket of my own tears. And it's all because you're so mad at me; you just picked me up and threw me away. There's nothing left of me—I'm like a dead weed, just swept off the street.

But you, God, you're still in charge, forever and always. You're gonna get up and show some love to Zion—it's time for you to be compassionate. Your people really love this city, even its broken-down parts, and they cry over its dust. All the other nations who don't know you are gonna see what's up—they'll see your glory and respect your name—when you rebuild Zion and show up in all your awesomeness, when you actually listen to the prayers of the broken. You won't just ignore them.

Write this down for the next generation, so that people who aren't even born yet will praise God: 'God looked down from his holy place up high; from heaven, he checked out the earth. He heard the groans of people about to die, and he set them free from their death sentences.' Write it down so everyone in Zion can tell the story, so God's praise is sung in the streets of Jerusalem, and wherever people and their leaders get together to worship him.

God, you totally brought me to my knees; you cut my life short. 'Oh, please don't,' I begged, 'please don't let me die now. You've got more years than anyone could count! A super long time ago, you made the foundations of the earth, and you personally made the heavens. They'll be long gone, worn out like an old t-shirt, but you'll still be here. You'll just toss them out like an old coat, but you're brand new year after year. The kids of your servants will have a safe place to live, and their kids will be secure with you.'

title: God's Love is Lowkey GOATED
paragraphs: Yo, my soul, praise God! Like, from my head to my toes, I'm gonna praise His holy name. Seriously, my soul, praise God and don't you forget a single good thing He's done.

He forgives all your screw-ups—every single one. He heals all your sicknesses—every single one. He pulls you back from the brink of disaster—He saves your life! He showers you with love and compassion, like a king giving you a crown. He surrounds you with good things, making you feel brand new. He gives you back your energy, so you feel young and fresh whenever you're with Him.

God always makes things fair; He helps people who've been wronged get back up. He showed Moses His game plan, and let all of Israel in on His secrets. God is all about mercy and grace; He doesn't get mad easily, and He's got so much love to give. He's not gonna keep nagging you or hold a grudge forever. He doesn't give us the punishment we deserve for our mistakes. His love for those who respect Him is as huge as the sky. And He's thrown our sins as far away from us as the east is from the west. As parents feel for their children, God feels for those who fear him. He knows exactly what we're made of, and remembers we're just human. People don't live forever; we're like wildflowers that pop up and look pretty for a little while, but then a storm comes and they're gone. But God's love is forever, for everyone who respects Him. He makes things right for them and their families, as long as they stick to His promises and do what He says.

God's got His throne set up in heaven; He's the king of everything. So praise God, you angels, who are always ready to do what He says. Praise God, all you angel armies, who are always on call for Him. Praise God, everything He's made, wherever you are.
And you, my soul, praise God!

title: God's Creation is Actually Insane
paragraphs: §Yo, my soul, praise God!

God, my God, you're so incredibly great! You're decked out in the most beautiful, glorious clothes, literally wearing sunshine, with the entire sky as your tent. You built your palace on the deep oceans, made a chariot from the clouds, and flew on the wings of the wind. You use winds as your messengers and fire and flames as your ambassadors. You set the earth on a solid foundation so nothing can ever shake it. You covered the earth with the ocean, burying the mountains in deep water; then you just had to shout, and the water ran away—your thunder made it retreat. Mountains rose up, and valleys sank to the places you set for them. You created a boundary between the land and the sea, so the earth will never be flooded again. You made springs and rivers flow through the hills. Now all the wild animals can get a drink, and even the wild donkeys can quench their thirst. Birds build their nests along the riverbanks, and you can hear ravens singing. You water the mountains from your home in the sky, and the earth has all the water it needs. You make grass grow for the cattle and crops for the animals that help us farm.

For real, God brings food from the ground, wine that makes people happy, and makes them healthy and glowing. People are well-fed and strong. God's trees, the cedars of Lebanon he planted, are always watered. Birds build their nests in them; look—the stork has a home in the treetops. The cliffs are for the mountain goats, and the rocks are a place for badgers to hide. The moon marks the seasons, and the sun knows when to set. When you make it dark and night comes, all the creatures in the forest come out. Young lions roar for their prey, asking God for their food. When the sun rises, they disappear and go back to their dens to chill. Meanwhile, people go out to work, staying busy until the evening.

What a wild and wonderful world, God! You created it all with your wisdom, and the earth is full of your amazing creations. And look—the ocean, so deep and wide, is filled with more fish than you can count, from tiny sardines to huge sharks. Ships sail on it, and Leviathan, your pet sea monster, plays in it. All these creatures look to you to give them their food on time. You show up, and they gather around; you open your hand, and they eat their fill. If you were to turn away, they would die in a second. If you took back your breath, they would die and turn back to dust. But when you send out your Spirit, they come to life—and the whole world blooms and blossoms.
May God's glory last forever! May God enjoy his own creation! He just looks at the earth, and it shakes; he points at the mountains, and volcanoes erupt.

I'm going to sing to God for my whole life, sing praises to my God as long as I'm alive! I hope my song makes him happy; I'm so happy to be singing to God. But let's get rid of the sinners—no more godless people!
Yo, my soul, praise God!

title: God's Epic Throwback: The Israel Story
paragraphs: §Let's gooo!

Give a massive shoutout to God! Pray to him directly, and tell everyone you meet about the incredible things he's done. Sing him anthems, belt out worship songs, and turn his amazing acts into viral hits! Rep his holy name with a big 'Hallelujah,' all you who are searching for God. Live your best life! Always be on the lookout for God, watch for his moves, and stay alert for signs he's around. Don't forget the world of wonders he's created, his miracles, and the solid judgments he's made—you descendants of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen crew.

He's our God, the one in charge of the whole world. And he never forgets his promise—for a thousand generations, he's kept his word. It's the same deal he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac, the rule he set with Jacob, and the forever-promise with Israel. He said, 'I'm giving you this land. Canaan is your inheritance.' Back when they were just a small group, total outsiders, wandering from one country to another, he didn't let anyone mess with them. He even warned kings, 'Don't you dare touch my chosen ones, don't even think about harming my prophets.'

Then he hit the land with a famine, wiping out their food supply. But he had already sent a guy ahead of them: Joseph, who was sold as a slave. They chained up his ankles and put an iron collar on his neck, until God's plan was revealed to Pharaoh, and God's promise was proven true. God sent the king to free him. Pharaoh let Joseph go and made him the boss of his entire palace, in charge of everything. Joseph was the one teaching the princes and training the advisors.

Then Israel went to Egypt, and Jacob's family moved to the Land of Ham. God blessed his people with tons of kids, and soon their numbers freaked out their enemies. He made the Egyptians turn on his people; they started tricking and abusing God's servants. So he sent his servant Moses, and Aaron, who he also picked. They performed some wild miracles in that spiritually dead place, amazing signs in the Land of Ham. He said, 'Darkness!' and it went pitch black—so dark they couldn't see a thing. He turned their water into blood, and all their fish died. He made frogs swarm everywhere, even in the king's bedroom. He gave the order, and flies swarmed in, with gnats filling the air. He swapped their rain for hail and zapped their land with lightning. He destroyed their grapevines and fig trees and shattered all the trees in their groves. With just a word, he brought in swarms of locusts, millions of them, like an army. They ate every single blade of grass and cleaned out all the crops. Then he struck down every firstborn in the land, the first son of every family. He led Israel out, loaded with treasure, and not a single person in his tribes even tripped. Egypt was actually happy to see them go—they were terrified of them. God spread a cloud to keep them cool during the day and a fire to light up the night. They asked, and he brought them quail and filled them up with bread from heaven. He split open a rock, and water gushed out, flowing like a river through the desert—all because he remembered his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.

Remember this! He led his people out shouting for joy; his chosen crew marched out singing their hearts out! He gave them the lands of other nations and let them take over the wealth they had built up, so they could follow all his commands and live by his rules to the letter.
Hallelujah!

title: Israel's Epic Fail Compilation (God's Patience is GOATED)
paragraphs: Hey, let's go! Give it up for God! Why? 'Cause He's good and His love is, like, forever. But for real, who can even list all the epic stuff God's done? Who can shout out all His praises? You're legit happy when you do the right thing, when you make a habit of being fair.

Hey God, remember me when You're blessing Your people. Count me in when You save them. I wanna see Your chosen crew win, celebrate with Your nation, and join in the hype when everyone's cheering for You!

We messed up, big time. Us and our ancestors. We fell short and hurt a lot of people. After our parents bounced from Egypt, they totally forgot about all the miracles You did. They forgot how incredibly loving You were. They were barely past the Red Sea and they were already defying the Most High God. Right at the spot where He saved them! Where He showed off His amazing power! He just told the Red Sea to dry up, and it did. He walked them right through it, and nobody even got their feet wet. He saved them from being oppressed and rescued them from the enemy. Then the water came crashing back down on their enemies, and not a single one survived. That's when they finally believed what He said and started singing His praises.

But it didn't take long for them to forget the whole thing. They wouldn't even wait for instructions. They were only thinking about themselves out there in the desert, pushing God's buttons with their non-stop demands. So He gave them what they wanted, but it came with a side of emptiness in their hearts. Then one day in camp, some people got jealous of Moses, and also of Aaron, God's holy priest. The ground literally opened up and swallowed one guy, Dathan, and then buried another guy's crew, Abiram's. Fire just flared up and torched that whole rebel squad.

They made a metal statue of a calf at Horeb and started worshiping it. They traded the awesome Glory of God for a cheap statue of a grass-eating bull! They forgot God, their own Savior, the one who did all those amazing things back in Egypt, who created a world of wonders in Ham's territory, and who put on that stunning show at the Red Sea.

God was so over it, He was ready to just wipe them out. And He would have, if it wasn't for Moses, His chosen one. Moses stood in the gap, like a total legend, and deflected God's anger, stopping Him from completely destroying them. But then they went and rejected the amazing land God promised them. They didn't believe a single word He said. They just complained about their lives and wouldn't listen to God's voice. God was so fed up, He swore He'd make them fall in the desert, and scatter their kids all over the world.

Then they started worshiping this idol, Baal Peor, and went to parties for dead gods, eating food sacrificed to idols. That made God so mad that a plague broke out. But this guy, Phinehas, stood up and prayed for them, and the plague stopped. That was a major good deed, and his family will always be remembered for it.
They made God angry again at a place called Meribah Springs. This time, Moses got dragged into their mess. Because they defied God again, Moses just lost it and blew up at them.

They didn't wipe out the other nations like God told them to. Instead, they married people from those cultures and ended up becoming just like them. They worshiped their idols and got caught in that trap. They even sacrificed their own sons and daughters to demons. They killed their own babies, their little boys and girls. They offered them to the gods of Canaan, and the whole land was stained with their blood. Their whole way of life was disgusting; they were acting like prostitutes.

And God was furious. Like, wildfire angry. He couldn't even look at His own people. He handed them over to other nations, and the people who hated them ended up ruling them. Their enemies made their lives miserable, and they were totally crushed under their rule. God rescued them over and over, but they never learned their lesson. In the end, their own sins destroyed them.

But still, when God saw how much trouble they were in and heard them crying for help, He remembered the promise He made to them. And because His love is so huge, He took them by the hand. He showed them mercy, and even their captors were amazed.
Save us, God, our God! Bring us back from all the places we've been scattered, so we can thank Your holy name and celebrate how glorious You are!
Shout out to God, the God of Israel! Bless Him now and forever! And let everyone say, 'Amen!' Hallelujah!

title: God's Rescue Mission is GOATED
paragraphs: Yo, give a massive shoutout to God—He's legit so good! His love is, like, endless. For real. All you guys who God set free, you gotta tell everyone! Spread the word about how He rescued you from all the bad vibes and brought you all together from, like, literally everywhere—east, west, north, south.

Some of y'all were basically lost in the desert for ages, searching for a place to crash but finding nothing. You were starving, super thirsty, just stumbling around, about to totally collapse. Then, when you were at your absolute lowest, you hit up God. And boom, He came in clutch, saving you just in time. He set you on a straight path to a solid place to live. So, you gotta thank God for His insane love, for the wild miracles He does for His kids. He gave water to the thirsty and fed the hungry until they were stuffed.

Others of you were locked up in a dark prison, trapped and feeling hopeless. You were there because you ignored what God said and thought you knew better. It was a tough time, your heart felt heavy, and there was no one to help. Then, in that mess, you cried out to God. And just like that, He got you out. He busted you out of that dark cell, broke the chains, and led you to freedom. So, thank God for His mind-blowing love and all the awesome things He does. He smashed through heavy prison doors and snapped the bars like they were nothing.

Some of you got super sick because you were living a wild life, and your body was paying the price for your choices. You couldn't even look at food, and you felt so miserable you wished it was all over. Then, at rock bottom, you called out to God. And He pulled through, saving you right when you needed it most. He said the word and you were healed, pulling you back from the edge. So, thank God for His amazing love and the incredible things He does for His people. Give thanks, tell the world what He's done—sing it loud!

And for those of you who were sailors, doing business across the sea. You saw God's power firsthand, the crazy things He can do with the ocean. He'd just say the word and a massive storm would hit, with waves as tall as buildings! You'd be tossed up to the sky and then dropped down low, your stomach in your throat. You were spinning around, totally lost and confused. Then, in the middle of that chaos, you cried out to God. And He saved you. He calmed the wind down to a whisper and silenced the huge waves. You were so relieved when the storm passed, and He guided you safely back to the shore. So, thank God for His incredible love and the miraculous things He does. Praise Him in front of everyone, shout 'Hallelujah' when the leaders get together!

God can turn rivers into deserts and springs into dry land. He can make fruitful orchards turn into salty wasteland, all because of the messed-up things people do. But then, He can flip it, turning that wasteland into a place with pools of water and fresh springs. He brings in the hungry and gives them a great place to live. They plant fields and vineyards and get a huge harvest. He blesses them, and they do really well, their families and their animals growing in number. But all the bad stuff—the abuse and trouble—starts to fade away as He puts a stop to the arrogant leaders. He gives the poor a safe place to live and takes care of their families like a shepherd with his sheep.
Good people see all this and get hyped; the bad people are left speechless, totally shook. If you're smart, you'll really think about all this. It's time to actually get how deep God's love is.

title: God's Ultimate Hype Song
paragraphs: I’m so ready, God, like, 100% all in. Ready to sing my heart out and write a song for You. Let's go, soul! Wake up, guitar! Rise and shine, sleepy sun!

I’m shouting you out, God, on every street, singing your praises everywhere I go. Your love is, like, crazy deep and reaches way high; every cloud is basically a billboard for how faithful you are. Soar high, God! Let your glory cover the whole world! And because you love me so much, please reach down and help me out—answer me!

Then God said something epic from his holy place: “I’m so stoked, I’m giving away Shechem as a present and handing out the Succoth Valley like it’s nothing. Gilead is mine, and so is Manasseh. Ephraim is my helmet, and Judah is my gavel. Moab is just a bucket I use to clean the floors, I’ll diss Edom, and set off fireworks all over Philistia.”
Who’s gonna get me into the middle of the action? Who’s gonna show me the way to Edom? You’re not ditching us, are you, God? You’re not gonna sit on the sidelines while our crew goes out?
Please help us with this tough mission; getting help from people is pretty useless. With God, we’ll do amazing things; He’ll totally crush the opposition for good.

title: My Ultimate Prayer Against the Haters
paragraphs: My God, please don't ignore me when I'm praising you. People are spreading lies and trash-talking me. Their lies are like a pack of dogs just trying to attack me, barking hate and tripping me up for literally no reason! I was good to them, and now they're slandering me—for real!—and acting like my prayer is a joke. They pay me back with evil for my good, and hate for my love.

Go ahead and let some evil person accuse my accuser; let Satan himself be the one to prosecute him. When he's judged, let the verdict be 'guilty,' and when he prays, let his prayer just count as another sin. Give him a short life, and let someone else take his job. Make his kids orphans and his wife a widow. Let his children become homeless beggars, kicked out of their ruined homes. I hope the bank takes everything he has, and that strangers just come and pick his stuff clean like vultures. I hope there's no one left to be kind to him, and no one willing to help out his orphaned kids. Just erase his family line so no one even remembers his name. But build a monument to his father's sin, and make sure his mother's name is on it too—let their sins be on display before God forever, while they are completely forgotten. That's what he gets, since he was never kind to anyone and just hunted down the poor and heartbroken until they died. Since he loved cursing people so much, let curses rain down on him. Since he hated blessing others, let blessings stay far away from him. He wore curses like they were his favorite outfit; he drank curses and bathed in them. So here's a gift for him—a whole wardrobe of curses. Let him wear curses every single day. That's what they deserve, the ones who are trying to get me—a huge serving of justice from God.

Oh God, my Lord, please step in and do something amazing for me—I know you can! Your love is so great, so please get me out of this mess. I'm at my breaking point, my life is a wreck. I feel like I'm just fading away, disappearing. I'm getting old before I'm even supposed to. I'm so weak from not eating I can barely stand, and I'm just skin and bones. I'm a total joke to everyone who sees me; they just look at me and shake their heads in disgust.

Help me, please help me, God, my God! Save me because your love is so awesome. Then they'll know that you were the one who did this, that you, God, were behind it all. Let them curse me all they want; you can just bless me. Let them get totally embarrassed when they stand up to me, while everyone cheers for me, your servant. Dress up my accusers in clothes that are dirty with shame, like some nasty, humiliating old rags.
My mouth is just full of praise for God. I'm singing his praises in front of everyone, because he's always there for the people who need him, to save them from anyone who judges them unfairly.

title: Level Up: The King's Forever Reign
paragraphs: God's message to my main man, the King: 'Yo, come chill with me on my throne. I'm gonna make your haters your footstool.' God basically handed you this super strong scepter from Zion, so now you're in charge, even with enemies all around. Your crew will totally have your back, decked out in holy gear on the day you win big. They'll be with you from the crack of dawn, full of energy like they just woke up.

God made a promise and He's not backing down: you're a priest forever, in the same way Melchizedek was. The Lord is right there with you, taking down kings when He gets seriously mad. He's bringing justice to all the nations, no holding back, and shutting down anyone who stands against Him. The one who makes kings put *this* King on the throne, and He's ruling with total confidence.

title: God's Work is GOATED, No Cap
paragraphs: Hallelujah! I'm giving God a massive shout-out with everything I have—doesn't matter if I'm just with my friends or in front of a huge crowd.
God's works are mind-blowing, you could literally spend your whole life studying them and never get bored. It's endless entertainment!
Everything He creates is just stunning and beautiful; and His generosity is wild, it just never stops.
His miracles are basically His highlight reel—a reminder of this God of Grace, this God of Love.
He provided for those who looked up to Him, and He always remembered to keep His promises from way back.
He proved to His people that He's not all talk; He literally handed them whole nations on a silver platter. What a gift!
He's in the business of truth and justice, and everything He makes is guaranteed to be legit and last forever—never going out of style, never becoming useless. It's all premium quality.
Everything He makes and does is 100% real and true. He paid the price to save His people and set up a promise that's meant to last for all time.

He's so personal and holy, totally worthy of our respect. The good life really starts when you have a healthy respect for God—do that, and you'll experience His blessing for real. His Hallelujah is eternal!

title: How to Live a Blessed Life, No Cap
paragraphs: Hallelujah! Shout out to the person who has major respect for God and is actually super into His commands.
Their kids will be legends in the land, and the family of the upright will be totally blessed. Their house will be full of riches, and their good deeds will last forever.

Even when it's dark, a light shines for the good people—because God is gracious, merciful, and just. It's a good thing when a person is generous and lends freely; they handle their business with fairness. For real, they will never be shaken. A good person will be remembered forever.

They're not fazed by bad news; their heart is steady, trusting in God. Their mind is secure, they're not afraid; in the end, they'll see their enemies go down. They've given generously to the poor; their righteousness lasts forever. They will be honored and respected.
The wicked person will see all this and get furious; they'll grind their teeth and then just fade away. The hopes of the wicked? They'll come to nothing.

title: From Zero to Hero: God's Ultimate Glow-Up
paragraphs: Yooo, let's go! If you're on Team God, you better be hyping Him up! Seriously, just saying His name is a whole vibe. Thinking about Him is a total win, like, forever and ever. From sunrise to sunset, east to west, make sure you're sending up praises to God!

God is on a whole other level, literally higher than anyone or anything. He outshines everything in the sky. Like, for real, who can even compare to our God? He's sitting on His throne, looking over all of heaven and earth. He sees the people who are struggling, the ones who feel like they've been thrown away, and He picks them right up. He doesn't just rescue them, He gives them a best seat with the most important people. And for couples who can't have kids, He gives them a family and the crazy joy of being parents. Let's go, God! Hallelujah!

title: When God Shows Up, Nature Freaks Out
paragraphs: When Israel bounced from Egypt, when Jacob's crew ditched that foreign-speaking crowd, Judah became His special spot, and Israel was the place He'd rule.

The Red Sea saw them coming and literally parted ways. The Jordan River? It straight up reversed course. The mountains were so shook they started skipping like rams, and the little hills were jumping around like baby lambs.
So, what's the deal, Sea? Why'd you run? And Jordan River, why'd you back up like that? And you mountains, why were you skipping like rams? You hills, why were you jumping around like lambs?
Yo, Earth, you better tremble! You're in the presence of the Lord, the God of Jacob. This is the God who can make a rock gush with water, and turn a flinty cliff into a freshwater spring..

title: Our God is Real, Theirs are Fake
paragraphs: Look, God, this isn't about us. Seriously, not for our sake. This is for YOUR name's sake, to show off your glory. Do it because you're all about that merciful love and you're always true to your word. Do it so none of the other nations can be like, "So, uh, where's their God at now?"

Our God is in heaven, doing literally whatever He wants. Their gods? They're just metal and wood, basically DIY projects from a basement. They've got carved mouths that can't say a word, painted eyes that are blind, tin ears that can't hear a thing, and molded noses that can't smell. They have hands that can't hold anything, feet that can't walk or run, and throats that have never made a single sound. And get this: the people who make these things end up just like them—totally useless, just like the fake gods they trust in.

But you, Israel, you gotta put your trust in God! He's your Helper and your Protector. Clan of Aaron, trust in God! He's your Helper and your Protector. All you who have a healthy fear and respect for God, trust in God! He's your Helper and your Protector.

God, please remember us and bless us. Bless the whole family of Israel and the family of Aaron. And let God bless everyone who respects Him—the small and the great. Oh, and God, please make our families bigger—help us grow, and help our kids grow. May you be blessed by God, the one who made heaven and earth. The highest heavens are for God, but He put us in charge of the earth.

Dead people can't praise God—you won't hear a single word from those who are six feet under. But us? We're gonna bless God, oh yeah. We're blessing Him right now, and we'll bless Him forever. Hallelujah!

title: God Answered My Desperate Call
paragraphs: I love God so much because He actually listened to me when I was begging for mercy. He was paying super close attention as I laid out my whole situation to Him. It felt like death was staring me in the face, and things were getting real. I was totally stuck and didn't know what to do, so I just cried out to God for help: 'Please, God! Save my life!'
And He did! God is so gracious and always makes things right. He's the most compassionate God out there. He always takes the side of the helpless. When I was at my absolute lowest, He saved me.

I told myself, 'Just chill out and rest. God has showered you with blessings. My soul, you've been rescued from death; my eyes, you've been rescued from tears; and my feet, you were kept from stumbling.'

Now I'm walking in God's presence, alive and well! I kept my faith even when I was completely overwhelmed and had a ton of bad luck. I even got to a point where I was giving up on people, thinking, 'They're all liars and cheats.'

So what can I give back to God for all the amazing blessings He's poured out on me? I'll lift up the cup of salvation—a toast to God! I'll pray in God's name, and I'll follow through on what I promised Him I'd do, and I'll do it with His people.

When those who love God face death, He welcomes them. Oh, God, here I am, your servant, your faithful servant. Set me free so I can serve you! I'm ready to offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving and pray in God's name. I'll complete what I promised God I'd do, and I'll do it with His people, in the place of worship, in God's house, in Jerusalem, God's city. Hallelujah!

title: The Shortest Song with the Biggest Message
paragraphs: Hey, shout out to God, everybody! Let's give it up for God, all you people! His love for us is overwhelming, and you can count on Him to be faithful forever.. Hallelujah!

title: God's Got My Back, No Cap
paragraphs: Give it up for God, because he's so good. His love is, like, eternal. For real, Israel, tell everyone: 'His love never quits.' And you, Aaron's crew, you say it too: 'His love never quits.' And anyone who respects God, you get in on this: 'His love never quits.'

I was in a tight spot, seriously cornered, so I hit up God. And from this huge, open place, he answered me. Now God's on my side, so I'm not even scared. Like, who would even try to mess with me? God's my ultimate champion, so I can just brush off my haters like they're nothing. It's way better to trust God than to count on people, and it's definitely better to trust God than to rely on famous people. I was surrounded by enemies, but in God's name, I totally owned them. I was trapped with no way out, but in God's name, I showed them who's boss. They came at me like a swarm of bees, like a wildfire, but in God's name, I shut them down. I was literally about to fall off a cliff, and God just grabbed me and held on. God is my strength, he's my favorite song, and now, he's the one who saves me. You can hear the cheering, the victory songs from everyone who's been saved, right? 'God's hand just changed everything! God's hand is lifted up, we won! God's hand just turned it all around!'

I didn't die. I'm alive! And now I'm telling everyone what God did. God really put me to the test, he pushed me to my limit, but he never let me actually die. So open up the city gates—the gates for the good guys! I'm gonna walk right in and thank God! This Temple Gate is God's, so all the winners can come in and give him praise.

Thanks for answering me; you've seriously saved me! The stone that the builders thought was useless is now the most important one! This is all God's doing. We can't even believe our eyes—it's that amazing! This is the day God made happen—so let's party and have a good time! Save us now, God. Save us now! Oh yeah, God—give us a free and awesome life!

Big ups to you who come in God's name—we're blessing you from God's house! God is God, and he's lit up our lives. Let's decorate the place with cool garlands and hang colorful banners over the altar! You're my God, and I'm so thankful for you. Oh my God, I'm gonna shout your praise. Thank God—he's just so good. His love is for real, it never stops!

title: The Ultimate A-Z Guide to a Blessed Life
paragraphs: You’re seriously blessed when you stick to the path God laid out for you, just walking the road He revealed. You’re blessed when you follow His directions, trying your best to find Him. That’s right—you don’t just do your own thing; you walk straight on the path He made. You, God, showed us the right way to live, and now you expect us to actually live it. Man, I just hope my steps stay steady on the course you set; then I’d never have regrets when I check my life against your advice. I thank you for being so real with me; I’m learning the blueprint of your righteous ways. I’m gonna do what you tell me to do; just please don’t ever dip on me.

So, how can a young person live a clean life? By actually reading the map—your Word. I’m all in on chasing after you; don’t let me miss the signs you’ve put up. I’ve locked your promises in the vault of my heart so I don’t mess up and go spiritually broke. You are blessed, God; teach me your ways of wise living. I’ll tell everyone all the advice that comes from your mouth; for real, I get more joy from what you teach me about life than from stacking up a ton of cash. I think about every piece of wisdom from you, and I pay close attention to how you do things. I love everything you’ve told me about life; I won’t forget a single word of it.

Be generous with me and I’ll live my best life; I won’t take my eyes off your path for a second. Open my eyes so I can see the amazing, miraculous things you show me. I feel like a foreigner here; give me clear directions. My soul is starving, absolutely ravenous—always hungry for your life-giving commands. And those people who act like they know everything, ignoring what you say—put them in their place! Don’t let them clown on me; I’ve been careful to do exactly what you said. While the haters are gossiping about me, I’m just focused on your wise advice. Yep, your words on life are what bring me joy; I listen to them like good friends.

I’m feeling terrible—like, I couldn’t feel worse. Get me back on my feet again. You promised, remember? When I laid it all out for you, you answered; train me in your deep wisdom. Help me get it, inside and out, so I can really think about your amazing wonders. My sad life feels like a wreck, a total mess; build me up again with your Word. Block off the road that leads to nowhere; grace me with your clear truth. I’m choosing the true road, the one that goes somewhere, and I’m posting your signs at every turn. I’m holding on tight to everything you tell me; God, don’t let me down! I’ll run the race you’ve set for me if you’ll just show me how.

God, teach me the rules for living so I can stay on track. Give me the insight to follow what you say—my whole life just one long, obedient vibe. Guide me down the path of your commands; I love cruising on this freeway! Give me a hunger for your words of wisdom, not for just getting more stuff. Keep my eyes off of useless distractions; give me life on this journey with you. Confirm your promises to me—the ones you made to everyone who respects you. Block out the harsh words from my critics—what you say is always so good. See how hungry I am for your guidance; keep me alive through your righteous ways.

Let your love, God, shape my life with salvation, exactly like you promised. Then I’ll have a comeback for anyone who makes fun of me, because I trusted your Word. Don’t ever take your truth away from me—your commands are what I count on. Oh, I’ll protect what you’ve revealed to me with my life, now and forever. And I’ll walk freely in wide-open spaces as I search for your truth and wisdom. Then I’ll tell the world what I find, speak out boldly in public, with no shame. I treasure your commandments—man, I love them!—savoring every piece of your advice.

Remember what you said to me, your servant—I’m hanging on to those words for dear life. They keep me going in tough times; for real, your promises give me new life. The haters despise me like crazy, but I don’t move an inch from your truth. I look for your timeless words and know I’m on the right track. But when I see wicked people ignore your directions, I get so angry. I turn your instructions into songs and sing them as I walk this journey of life. I think about your name all night, God, treasuring your truth. Still, I get a lot of hate because I live by your Word and advice.

Because you’re all I need, God, I promise to do everything you say. I’m begging you from the bottom of my heart: smile and be gracious to me, just like you promised. When I took a long, hard look at my life, I got my feet back on the path you laid out. I got up right away, no hesitation, and was quick to follow your orders. The wicked had me trapped—there was no way out—but I didn’t forget your plan for me for a second. I get up in the middle of the night to thank you; your decisions are so right, so true—I can’t wait till morning! I’m a friend to everyone who respects you, to those who are committed to living by your rules. Your love, God, fills the whole earth! Teach me how to live by your guidance.

You’ve been good to your servant, God, just as good as your Word. Teach me good common sense; I’m all in on living your way. Before I learned to listen to you, I was all over the place, but now I’m in step with your Word. You are good, and the source of all good; train me in your goodness. The godless spread lies about me, but I just focus on what you’re saying. They’re as dull as a bucket of lard, while I’m dancing to the beat of your truth. My troubles actually turned out for the best—they forced me to learn from your playbook. The truth from your mouth means more to me than striking it rich.

With your own hands, you made me; now give me the wisdom to understand you. When those who respect you see me waiting and expecting your Word, they’ll be encouraged. I see now, God, that your judgments are right; your tests have taught me what’s true and right. Oh, love me—right now!—hold me tight, just like you promised. Now comfort me so I can really live; your truth is the song I dance to. Let the fast-talking fakes be exposed as frauds; they tried to scam me, but I kept my mind on your guidance. Let those who respect you turn to me to see your wise guidance in action. And let me live a whole and holy life, inside and out, so I can always walk with my head held high.

I’m homesick, longing for your salvation; I’m waiting for your word of hope. My eyes are getting tired from watching for a sign of your promise; how long do I have to wait for your comfort? My eyes are burning and watering from the smoke, but I keep a steady gaze on the instructions you post. How long do I have to deal with all this? When are you going to bring my enemies to justice? The arrogant, godless people try to throw me off course, totally clueless about you and your ways. Everything you command is a sure thing, but they keep harassing me with lies. Help! They’ve pushed and pushed—they never stop—but I haven’t let go of your guidance. In your great love, revive me so I can be ready to obey your every word.

What you say, God, is final and permanent, as eternal as the heavens. Your truth never gets old; it’s as relevant as the sunrise. Your Word and truth are as dependable as ever; that’s what you ordered when you set the earth in motion. If your truth hadn’t been such a joy to me, I would have given up when things got hard. But I’ll never forget the advice you gave me; you saved my life with those wise words. Save me! I’m all yours. I search everywhere for your words of wisdom. The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I’m only focused on your plans for me. I see that everything human has its limits, but your commands are limitless!

Oh, how I love everything you’ve revealed; I think about it all day long. Your commands give me an edge over my enemies; they never get outdated. I’ve even become smarter than my teachers because I’ve really absorbed your guidance. I’ve become wiser than the old experts simply by doing what you tell me. I watch my step, avoiding the traps of evil, so I can spend all my time keeping your Word. I never stray from the path you laid out; you gave me such good directions. Your words are so good, so tasty; I’d rather have them than the best home-cooked meal. With your instruction, I understand life; that’s why I hate all the fake news and propaganda.

Your words light up my path; they show me where I’m going in the dark. I’ve made a commitment and I’ll never go back on it: I will live by your righteous rules. Everything is falling apart around me, God; put me back together with your Word. Accept my heartfelt praise, God, and teach me your holy rules. My life is always on the line, but I don’t forget what you’ve revealed. The wicked do their best to trap me, but I don’t swerve an inch from your path. I’ve inherited your book on living; it’s mine forever—what a gift! And it makes me so happy. I’m focused on doing exactly what you say—I always have and I always will.

I hate two-faced people, but I love your clear-cut truth. You’re my safe space, my quiet retreat; I wait for your Word to refresh me. Get out of my life, you evildoers, so I can keep my God’s commands. Stand by me as you promised; then I’ll truly live. Don’t let all my big hopes be for nothing. Stick with me and I’ll be okay; I’ll give my full loyalty to your definitions of life. You expose everyone who drifts from your truth; their casual worship is deadly. You get rid of the wicked on earth like trash; that’s why I lovingly embrace everything you say. I tremble in awe before you; your judgments leave me speechless.

I’ve stood up for what’s right and just; don’t leave me at the mercy of my oppressors. Take my side, good God; don’t let the godless take advantage of me. My eyes are tired from waiting for you to keep your promise to set things right. Deal with me according to your love; teach me from your life-manual. I’m your servant—help me understand what that means, the deeper meaning of your instructions. It’s time to act, God; they’ve made a total mess of your truth! Yes, God, I love what you command, more than gold and jewels. Yes, God, I honor everything you tell me; I hate every deceptive path.

Every word you give me is a miracle—how could I not obey? When you break open your words, light shines out, and even ordinary people get the meaning. With my mouth open, panting, I wanted your commands more than anything. Turn my way, look at me with kindness, as you always do for those who love you. Guide my steps with your Word of promise so nothing evil gets control of me. Rescue me from the grip of bad people so I can live life your way. Smile on me, your servant; teach me the right way to live. I cry rivers of tears because nobody is living by your book!

You are right and you do right, God; your decisions are always on point. You rightly teach us how to live, always faithful to you. My rivals nearly took me out; they constantly ignored your commands. Your promise has been tested and proven true, and I, your servant, love it so much. I might be young and unimportant, but I don’t forget what you tell me. Your righteousness is forever right, and your revelation is the only truth. Even when troubles hit me hard, your commands always brought me joy. The way you tell me to live is always right; help me understand it so I can live life to the fullest.

I’m crying out with all I’ve got, “God! Answer me! I’ll do whatever you say.” I called to you, “Save me so I can follow all your instructions.” I was up before sunrise, crying for help, hoping for a word from you. I stayed awake all night, prayerfully thinking about your promise. In your love, listen to me; in your justice, God, keep me alive. As those who are out to get me get closer, they get farther from the truth you reveal. But you’re the closest of all to me, God, and all your judgments are true. I’ve known all along from your words that you meant them to last forever.

Take a good look at my trouble and help me—I haven’t forgotten your truth. Take my side and get me out of this; give me back my life, just as you promised. “Salvation” is just nonsense to the wicked because they’ve never bothered to look it up in your dictionary. Your mercies, God, are countless; following your rules, revive me. My enemies are too many to count, but I don’t turn away from the directions you gave. I took one look at the quitters and was disgusted; they just casually walked away from your promises. See how much I love what you tell me; out of your life of love, extend my life. All your words add up to one thing: Truth. Your righteous decisions are eternal.

The powerful people have been spreading lies about me, but my awe of your words keeps me steady. I’m so excited about what you say, like someone who just found a treasure. I hate lies—can’t stand them!—but I love what you have revealed. Seven times a day I stop and shout praises for how you keep everything running perfectly. For those who love your truth, everything just clicks—no stumbling around in the dark for them. I wait with expectation for your salvation; God, I do what you tell me. My soul guards and keeps all your instructions—oh, how much I love them! I follow your directions and live by your advice; my whole life is an open book before you.

Let my cry come right to you, God; give me the insight that only comes from your Word. Give my request your personal attention; rescue me based on your promise. Let praise pour from my lips, because you’ve taught me the truth about life. And let your promises be on my tongue; every command you’ve given is right. Put your hand out and keep me steady, since I’ve chosen to live by your guidance. I’m homesick, God, for your salvation; I love it when you show yourself. Give life to my soul so I can praise you well; use your laws to make me strong. And if I wander off like a lost sheep—come find me! I’ll recognize the sound of your voice.

title: Done with all the Fake People
paragraphs: I'm in a really tough spot, so I'm crying out to God, desperate for help. I'm like, "God, you gotta get me away from these liars. They act so sweet to my face but are totally fake."
You know what's coming for you, all you bold-faced liars? You're gonna get what's coming to you, like sharp arrows and burning coals. That's your reward.

I feel like I'm stuck living in a place like Meshech, cursed to have a home in Kedar. My whole life is like camping out with neighbors who are always fighting. I'm all about peace, but the second I mention it, they're ready to start a war.

title: God's Got Your Back, 24/7
paragraphs: I'm looking up at the huge mountains and thinking, 'Is that where my help comes from?' Nah, my help comes from God, the one who literally made heaven, earth, and even these mountains.
He's not gonna let you trip up. Your Protector, God, isn't taking any naps. Seriously, no way! The one watching over Israel never even gets drowsy or sleeps.
God's your personal bodyguard, always right there with you—shielding you from getting burnt by the sun and protecting you from whatever the night throws at you.
God protects you from all kinds of bad stuff; he's literally guarding your life. He's got your back whether you're coming or going—right now, and forever.

title: Jerusalem Trip Was GOATED
paragraphs: When everyone was like, “Let’s go to God’s house,” I was so hyped. And now we’re actually here, inside Jerusalem’s walls! It’s unreal.

Jerusalem is such a vibe, literally built for worship. It’s the place where all the tribes of God come to give thanks, which is basically what being Israel is all about. They’ve even got thrones set up for making fair calls, the legendary thrones of David’s line.

Yo, pray for peace in Jerusalem! Good vibes to everyone who loves this city. To all my people inside, let’s all get along. And to anyone trying to start drama, stay away. For my family and friends, I’m saying it again: Peace. For God’s house, I’ll always give it my all.

title: Lookin' Up When You're Feelin' Down
paragraphs: I'm looking to you, God, the one who lives in heaven. I'm looking to you for help.

It's like this: you know how servants are always watching their master, waiting for a command? Or how a maid pays super close attention to her lady? That's how we are with you. We're just watching and waiting, holding our breath, hoping you'll show us some mercy.

Mercy, God, please have mercy! We've been kicked around for way too long. We've been totally dissed by those rich people who have it easy, and kicked when we're already down by those arrogant bullies.

title: If God Wasn't on Our Side?!
paragraphs: If God hadn't been on our side—Israel, let's all say it together!—if God hadn't been for us when everyone was against us, we would have been totally swallowed up by their crazy anger. We would've been swept away by a flood of rage, drowned in the chaos. We would've lost our lives in that wild, raging water.
But thank God, He didn't just leave us there. He didn't abandon us like a helpless bunny in a pack of mean dogs.
We escaped their bite, we got out of their traps, free as a bird. They lost their grip on us; we're free, flying high like a bird.
God's powerful name is our help, the same God who created the heavens and the earth.

title: God's Got Your Back, No Cap
paragraphs: Anyone who trusts in God is like Mount Zion—totally unshakable. Seriously, it's a rock-solid mountain you can always depend on.
Just like mountains surround Jerusalem, God surrounds his people. He always has, and he always will. That's a forever thing.
The power of bad people won't break what's meant for the good people, so they won't be pushed into doing something messed up.
God, please be good to your good people, the ones who are genuinely trying to do what's right.
But for those who bail and go down the wrong path, God will group them up with all the other troublemakers. Peace out to Israel!

title: From Tears to Cheers
paragraphs: It was totally unreal, like a dream, when God brought the exiles back to Zion. We were all laughing and singing, we just couldn't wrap our heads around how lucky we were. Everyone was talking about us, like, 'Wow, God really did something amazing for them!' And it was true, God was amazing to us, and we were so, so happy.

And now, God, please do it again! Bring some relief to our dry, struggling lives. So that those who planted seeds with heavy hearts will be able to shout with joy when the harvest comes. So that those who left feeling hopeless will come back laughing, with their arms full of blessings.

title: Chill, God's Got This
paragraphs: If God isn't the one building your life, you're just messing around with LEGOs. If God isn't protecting your city, the security guards are basically useless. It's pointless to hustle 24/7, stressing yourself out. Don't you get it? God loves giving his people a break.

Can't you see that kids are the best gift from God? They're like a super generous inheritance. Having kids when you're young is like a warrior having a ton of arrows. You're so lucky if you have a big family. Your haters won't even be able to touch you; you'll own them.

title: The Ultimate Guide to a Blessed Life
paragraphs: Seriously, if you respect God, you're set. Life's like a smooth, straight road when you're on His path. All your hard work? It's paying off, for real. Enjoy every bit of it, soak in all that goodness.

Your wife will be like a grapevine, popping out kids left and right, making your home feel like a whole vineyard. And your kids around the dinner table? They're like fresh olive shoots, full of potential. Just be amazed at how God says 'yes' to you. It's wild how much He blesses those who respect Him.
Live it up in Jerusalem, every single day. Get to see your grandkids, too. Peace out, Israel!

title: They Tried to Break Us, But God Had Other Plans
paragraphs: "Man, they've been messing with us since day one," that's Israel's story. "They've been on our case forever, but they could never actually take us down. It felt like their haters were dragging sharp plows right across our backs, leaving deep cuts. But God was like, 'Nah, not happening.' He's always on our side. Then He just snapped the ropes of those evil plow-guys to pieces."

Seriously, may everyone who hates Zion just face-plant in total embarrassment. Let them be like that weak grass growing on a roof that dries up before you can even cut it, before the workers can even bundle it up, before anyone can even say, "Yo, nice harvest! God bless you guys!"

title: From Rock Bottom to Redemption
paragraphs: God, for real, I've hit rock bottom. Please, hear my cry for help! Just listen, open your ears to what I'm saying. If you kept a list of every wrong thing we did, who would even have a chance? But it turns out, forgiveness is your thing, and that's why you're so respected.

I'm praying to God, my whole life is basically a prayer, and I'm just waiting to see what he'll say and do. My life is on the line for God, my Lord, waiting and watching until the morning, just waiting and watching.

So, Israel, wait and watch for God. With God's arrival comes love, and with it, a huge amount of redemption. There's no doubt about it—he'll redeem Israel, and buy them back from being captive to sin.

title: Just Chillin': A Guide to Staying Humble
paragraphs: God, for real, I'm not trying to be the main character or act like I'm all that. I haven't been sticking my nose in stuff that's not my business or dreaming up some huge, crazy plans.
I've actually just been chilling, keeping my heart quiet and humble. My soul is literally as content as a baby snuggled up in its mom's arms.
So yeah, Israel, just wait for God. Wait with hope. Hope now, and hope always!

title: God's Covenant Promise to David
paragraphs: Yo God, don't forget about David and all the struggles he went through! Remember how he made a serious promise to you, the big deal God of Jacob? He was like, 'I'm not even going home or sleeping until I find a place for God, a house for the real MVP, the God of Jacob.'
Remember when we heard the news in Ephrathah and got the full scoop at Jaar Meadows? We were all like, 'Let's go to the dedication! Let's go worship at God's feet!'

Get up, God, and enjoy your new chill spot, you and your awesome covenant ark. Get your priests looking sharp in righteousness, and get your people to sing this prayer: 'Show some love to your boy David; don't turn away from your chosen one.'

God made a promise to David, and He's not going to flake. He said, 'I'll put one of your own sons on your throne. And if your sons keep my covenant and learn my ways, their sons will keep the throne forever.' And God was like, 'Yep, I chose Zion. That's where I want my house. This is my forever home. I'm gonna bless everyone who comes here and feed the hungry. My priests will be decked out in salvation, and my people will be singing their hearts out. I'm gonna make this place shine for David and light it up for my anointed one. I'll make his enemies look like fools, but his crown will be sparkling.'

title: When the Whole Squad Vibes
paragraphs: Yo, it's seriously amazing and just plain beautiful when people get along.

It's like that super expensive anointing oil being poured over your head, running down your beard—yeah, like Aaron the priest's beard—and dripping all the way down to the collar of your robes. It's that special.
It's as refreshing as the dew on Mount Hermon rolling down the hills of Zion.
that's the spot where God commands the blessing to drop: life that lasts forever.

title: Night Shift Praise
paragraphs: Alright, everyone who serves God, let's give it up for Him! All you priests holding it down on the night shift at God's house, throw your hands up and praise God. And right back atcha, may the God of Zion, the one who made literally everything, bless you too.

title: The OG God vs. Fake Idols
paragraphs: Hey, praise God's name! Praise everything God does. All you priests on duty in God's temple, serving in the holy halls of our God, shout 'Hallelujah!' because God is so good. Sing some bangers to His awesome name. And why? Because God chose Jacob's family and claimed Israel as His special treasure.

I'm telling you, I've seen how great God is. Our Lord is way above all other so-called gods. He does whatever He wants, wherever and whenever. He controls the weather—making clouds, thunder, lightning, and rain, and even the wind. He took down the firstborn of Egypt, both people and animals. He really made Egypt pay attention, showing Pharaoh and his crew some insane miracles. Yeah, He defeated powerful nations and took out mighty kings—like Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og of Bashan, and all the kings in Canaan. Then He gave their land to Israel, a sweet piece of land for His people.

God, Your name is forever. God, You'll never be outdated. God always has His people's back; He's always there for them. The 'gods' of other nations are just cheap trinkets, like stuff made to be sold at a flea market. They have mouths but can't talk, eyes but can't see, and ears but can't hear. They're just dead wood and cold metal! And the people who make them and trust them end up just as lifeless.
Family of Israel, bless God! Family of Aaron, bless God! Family of Levi, bless God! All you who respect God, bless God! Shout out to God from Zion, the number one citizen of Jerusalem! Hallelujah!

title: God's Love is Legit Forever
paragraphs:
Give a huge shoutout to God! He totally deserves it.
His love is legit forever.
Give props to the God of all gods,
His love is legit forever.
Thank the Lord of all lords.
His love is legit forever.

Thank the God who works miracles,
His love is legit forever.
The God whose genius made the whole universe,
His love is legit forever.
The God who set the earth on top of the ocean,
His love is legit forever.
The God who lit up the sky with lights,
His love is legit forever.
The sun to rule the day,
His love is legit forever.
The moon and stars to watch over the night,
His love is legit forever.
The God who took out the firstborns in Egypt,
His love is legit forever.
And got Israel out from under their thumb,
His love is legit forever.
He took Israel by the hand with his mighty power,
His love is legit forever.
He split the Red Sea right down the middle,
His love is legit forever.
And led Israel straight through it,
His love is legit forever.
He totally wrecked Pharaoh and his army in the sea,
His love is legit forever.
The God who led his people through the desert,
His love is legit forever.
He crushed huge kingdoms left and right,
His love is legit forever.
He took down famous kings,
His love is legit forever.
He struck down Sihon, the Amorite king,
His love is legit forever.
And Og, the king of Bashan,
His love is legit forever.
Then he gave away their land like it was nothing,
His love is legit forever.
He handed it over to Israel.
His love is legit forever.

God remembered us when we were at our lowest,
His love is legit forever.
He saved us from getting stepped on,
His love is legit forever.
He takes care of everyone when they need it.
His love is legit forever.
Thank God, who did all of it!
His love is legit forever!

title: Our Enemies Will Get What's Coming to Them
paragraphs: We were just sitting by the rivers in Babylon, crying our eyes out, thinking about the good old days in Zion. We hung up our harps on the trees, not even wanting to play them. That's when the people who captured us started demanding we sing for them, totally mocking us, like, 'Sing us one of your happy Zion songs!'

But for real, how could we sing a song for God in a foreign land? If I ever forget you, Jerusalem, may my fingers literally shrivel up and become useless. May my tongue get stuck to the roof of my mouth if I don't remember you, if I don't consider you my greatest joy.

God, don't forget what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. They were shouting, 'Tear it down! Tear it down to its foundations!' And you, Babylon, you're doomed to destruction. Happy is the one who repays you for what you have done to us. Seriously, happy is the one who grabs your infants and smashes them against the rocks.

title: God's Got My Back, No Cap
paragraphs: Thank you! Seriously, my whole heart is screaming, "Thank you!" All the angels are listening as I sing my thanks. I'm on my knees facing your holy temple, and I'll say it again: "Thank you!" Thank you for your love and for always being so real. Your name and your word are the most legit things ever. The second I called out to you, you were right there. You gave me a huge boost of strength and confidence.

When all the leaders on earth hear what you have to say, God, they'll all say, "Thank you." They'll sing about all the amazing things you've done, like, "God's glory is seriously next level!" And here's the thing: God is way up high, but he sees everything down below. It doesn't matter how far away we are, he knows every little thing about us.

When I'm going through a tough time and everything is a mess, please keep me safe in the middle of all the chaos. With one hand, deal with my enemies, and with your other hand, save me. God, please finish the good work you started in me. Your love lasts forever—so please don't give up on me now.

title: God's Got Me Covered 24/7
paragraphs: God, seriously, check out my life; get the real story firsthand. I'm a total open book to you; even from way off, you know what's on my mind. You know when I'm heading out and when I'm coming back; I'm literally never out of your sight. You know everything I'm about to say before I even get the first word out. I look over my shoulder and you're there, then I look ahead and you're there too—your comforting vibe, always with me. This is honestly too much, too amazing—I can't even wrap my head around it!

Is there anywhere I can go to ditch your Spirit? To get out of your sight? If I shoot up to the sky, you're there! If I go deep underground, you're there! If I took off on the fastest flight to the other side of the world, you'd find me in a second—you're already there waiting! Then I thought to myself, 'Whoa, he even sees me in the dark! At night, I'm basically surrounded by light!' It's true: darkness isn't even dark to you; night and day, dark and light, they're all the same to you.

Oh yeah, you made me from the inside out; you put me together in my mom's womb. I gotta thank you, High God—you're just breathtaking! Body and soul, I'm amazingly made! I'm in awe just thinking about it—what a masterpiece! You know me completely, every single bone in my body; you know exactly how I was made, piece by piece, how I was created from nothing into something. Like an open book, you watched me grow from the very beginning to birth; all the parts of my life were laid out in front of you, the days of my life all planned out before I'd even lived one.

Your thoughts—they're so rare, so beautiful! God, I'll never get them completely! I couldn't even start to count them—no more than I could count the grains of sand on the beach. Oh, let me wake up in the morning and just be with you always! And please, God, get rid of all the evil for good! And you murderers—get out of here!—all the guys and girls who disrespect you, God, obsessed with cheap knock-off gods. See how much I hate those who hate you, God, see how I can't stand all this godless pride; I hate it with a pure, intense hatred. Your enemies are my enemies!

Check my life, O God, find out everything about me; question me and test me, get a clear picture of what I'm really like; See for yourself if I've done anything wrong—then lead me on the path to eternal life.

title: My Prayer Against the Haters
paragraphs: God, for real, get me out of this mess. Protect me from these genuinely bad people. All they do is scheme up new ways to be awful; they literally spend all day plotting drama and conflict. Their words are like weapons, sharp and designed to hurt, totally venomous stuff that could ruin someone.

God, keep me away from the grip of these wicked people, protect me from their vicious vibes. They're all talk and ego, constantly plotting to trip me up and determined to see me fail. These haters are setting up traps to catch me and trying their best to frame me.

I prayed, "God, you're my God! Please, listen to me! Have mercy! God, my Lord, my strong Savior, protect me when the fighting starts! Don't let the wicked get what they want, God, don't give them even an inch!"

These troublemakers all around me—let them get tangled up in their own toxic talk. Let God hit them with some serious consequences, like fire from the sky, and let them fall into a pit they can't climb out of! Don't let anyone take these loudmouths seriously; let their own savagery come back to bite them.

I know that you, God, are on the side of the victims, that you fight for the rights of the poor. And I know that the good people will give you a personal shout-out, that they are secure and can chill in your presence.

title: Keep Me Safe From the Bad Guys
paragraphs: Yo God, get over here, ASAP! Can you hear me? I'm shouting you out. Hope my prayer is like that good-smelling incense, and when I lift my hands, it's like my nightly sign-off to you.

God, for real, put a filter on my mouth. Like, a security guard for my lips. Don't let me even think about messing up or accidentally slide in with the wrong crowd. And those people who are always up to no good—don't let their smooth talk get to me. I need the real one to check me, the kind one to put me right. Don't let bad vibes be my crown. I'm seriously praying against all their messed-up plans. Yo, let their leaders get tossed off a cliff; it's time for them to face the consequences. Like a rock pulverized by a maul, let their bones be scattered at the gates of hell.

But for real, God, my Lord, you're the only one I'm looking at. I'm running to you like my life depends on it, so please, have my back. Keep me safe from their shady plots and all their sneaky traps. Let the bad guys totally fail, while I just walk away, not even a scratch on me.

title: God, I'm at my breaking point
paragraphs: I'm screaming out to God, like, for real shouting, begging him to show me some love. I'm just dumping all my problems on him, telling him every single thing that's going wrong.

“Honestly, I'm starting to lose it, my energy is just gone. But you, God, you see what I'm going through. You know the mess I'm in, all the sneaky traps people have set for me. I look around, and it's like no one even cares. I'm totally cornered with no way out—it's just me. So I'm yelling out to you, God, saying, 'You're my only shot, the only thing keeping me going!' Please, just listen to me; I've never felt this crushed. Save me from the people chasing me down; I can't take them on by myself. Get me out of this prison so I can praise you in front of everyone. Your people will all gather around me, and you'll bless me like crazy!”

title: God, I'm at My Limit RN
paragraphs: Yo God, listen to my prayer, for real. Pay attention to what I’m asking. You’re known for coming through, so answer me and do what’s right.
But please, don’t drag me to court. Let’s be honest, no one would get a not-guilty verdict there.

The enemy has been hunting me down, beat me up, and left me for dead. They threw me in a dark place, buried like I’m already gone. I was so down, my spirit was just draining away, and my heart felt heavy like a rock. I started thinking about the old days, all the amazing things you’ve done, and just how you work. I reached out my hands to you, feeling as thirsty for you as a desert is for rain.

Hurry up and answer me, God! I’m at my limit. Don’t turn away from me, because that would literally be the end of me. Wake me up every morning with your loving voice, and I’ll go to bed each night trusting you. Show me the right path to take; I’m all ears and ready to follow. Save me from my enemies, God—you’re my only shot! Teach me how to live a life that makes you happy, because you’re my God. Lead me by your awesome Spirit to a good and safe place.

Come through, God, and give me life! In your fairness, get me out of this mess! In your great love, get rid of my enemies; just wipe out everyone who’s making my life miserable. And why? Because I’m your servant.

title: God: My Ultimate Protector & Shield
paragraphs: Shoutout to God, my rock, who trains me to face my battles head-on and with integrity. He's my foundation, my safe house, my knight in shining armor. He's the high ground I run to for safety, and he takes down my enemies for me.
Honestly, God, it's wild that you even care about us. Why do you bother with us at all? We're just like a puff of smoke, like shadows from a bonfire that disappear in a second.

God, come down from heaven and show your power. Make the mountains tremble. Unleash your lightning everywhere; send your arrows flying. Reach down from the sky and pull me out of this sea of hatred, away from these toxic people who lie to my face and stab me in the back after a handshake.
O God, I'm going to write a new song for you, and I'll play it on my guitar. It's a song for the God who saves leaders, the God who rescued his boy David.
Save me from my enemies, and get me away from these fake people who lie straight to your face and then betray you.

Let our sons grow up strong and dependable, like sturdy oak trees. Let our daughters be as beautiful and vibrant as a field of wildflowers. Let our storage be full of food, and our fields be full of animals. Keep us safe from attacks and from being kicked out of our homes. Get rid of the crime in our neighborhoods.
Man, the people who have all this are so blessed. The people who have God as their God are truly blessed.

title: God is ALWAYS on Your Side (No Cap)
paragraphs: My God, my King, I'm gonna hype you up forever! Seriously, I'll praise your name for all of time.
I'll thank you every single day, like, forever and ever.
God is just so awesome, you can't even praise him enough. His greatness is, like, infinite.
Literally every generation is amazed by what you do. They all tell stories about your epic deeds.
Everyone's talking about how beautiful and amazing you are. I'm even writing songs about all the cool stuff you do.
The amazing things you do are basically front-page news. I could write a whole book about how great you are.
Everyone knows how good you are; your reputation for doing the right thing is spreading everywhere.
God is super merciful and full of grace. He doesn't get mad easily and he's got so much love to give.
God is good to everyone, no exceptions. Everything he does is just dripping with grace.
All of creation gives you a round of applause, God; your people give you a shout-out.
They talk about how glorious your kingdom is, and they can't stop talking about your power.
They're letting the whole world know how powerful you are for good, and how incredibly awesome your kingdom is.
Your kingdom is forever; you're not going anywhere.
God always keeps his promises, and everything he does is full of grace.
God helps people up when they're down on their luck, and gives a fresh start to those who are about to give up.
All eyes are on you, waiting expectantly; you give them their food right on time.
You're so generous, it's almost ridiculous. You shower your love on every living thing.
Everything God does is right—love is his signature move.
God is right there, listening to everyone who prays, as long as they're being real about it.
He does what's best for those who respect him—he hears their cries for help and saves them.
God has the backs of everyone who loves him, but it's game over for those who don't.
I can't stop praising God. Let every living thing bless his holy name, from now until forever!

title: Don't Trust Humans, Trust God!
paragraphs: Hallelujah! Yo, my soul, praise God! I'm gonna praise God my whole life, singing songs to my God as long as I'm alive.

Don't put your trust in so-called "experts" who don't know the first thing about real life, about saving your soul. They're just people, and they can't save you. When they die, all their big plans die with them. Instead, get help from the God of Jacob. Put your hope in God and you'll be seriously blessed! God made the sky, the earth, the sea, and every fish in it. He always keeps his promises. He stands up for people who are treated unfairly, and he feeds the hungry. God sets prisoners free, gives sight to the blind, and helps people who have fallen. God loves good people, protects foreigners, and takes care of orphans and widows. But he'll make quick work of the wicked.
God is in charge—always. The God of Zion is God forever! Hallelujah!

title: God's Got This: He's in Control of Everything
paragraphs: Hallelujah! Seriously, it’s awesome to sing praises to our God. Praise is beautiful, and it just feels right.

God’s the one rebuilding Jerusalem and bringing back all the scattered people of Israel. He’s there for the brokenhearted, patching up their wounds. He’s got all the stars counted and knows each one by name. Our Lord is so great, like, his power is off the charts, and you can’t even begin to grasp how much he knows and does. He lifts up the people who’ve been knocked down and throws the wicked into the trash.

Sing a thank-you song to God, and bust out your instruments for him. He’s the one who fills the sky with clouds, gets the rain ready for the earth, and makes the mountains green with grass. He feeds the cows and even the baby crows when they cry out. He’s not impressed by a powerful horse or how big someone’s muscles are. What really gets God’s attention is people who respect him and trust in his unfailing love.

Jerusalem, go worship God! Zion, praise your God! He’s made your city safe and has blessed all your kids. He keeps everything peaceful inside your borders and puts the best food on your tables. He sends out his commands to the world—and man, they get there fast! He lays down snow like a white blanket, scatters frost like it’s ash, and throws hail like he’s feeding birds. Who can even handle his winter? But then he says the word, and it all melts. He just breathes, and suddenly it’s spring again.
He talks to Jacob’s family the same way, giving his powerful words to Israel. He’s never done that for any other nation; they’ve never heard his commands. Hallelujah!

title: The Ultimate Praise Anthem
paragraphs:
Hallelujah! Shout it from the heavens, shout it from the highest peaks!
Praise Him, all you angels; praise Him, all His heavenly squad.
Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, you shining stars.
Praise Him, highest heavens, and you rain clouds up there.
Let them all praise God's name — He said the word, and boom, they existed!
He locked them into place for all time. He gave the order, and that's final — no take-backs.

Let them all praise God's name — it's the only name worth praising. His brightness outshines everything in heaven and on earth.
He built up His own people into something amazing — praise from everyone who loves God! Israel's praise, oh! Hallelujah!

title: Praise Party & Sword Dance!
paragraphs: Hey, let's go! Sing a brand-new song for God, and praise Him with the whole squad of people who love Him. The whole nation of Israel should celebrate their Creator, and all of Zion’s kids should be hyped about their King. Let them praise His name with some sick dance moves, get the band together, and make some epic music! And for real, why? Because God is super into His people, and He blesses humble folks with the awesome gift of salvation!

Let all the true fans of God shout out in praise, singing from wherever they are. Yell out the highest praises to God, and get ready with your swords, like a wild sword-dance—it's a sign that God's about to get back at the nations that don't follow Him, a warning that punishment is coming. Their kings will be chained up and thrown in jail, and their leaders will be locked up for good. The judgment written about them will happen for real—and everyone who loves God will have a place of honor! Hey, let's go!

title: The Ultimate Praise Sesh
paragraphs: Let's gooo! Give it up for God in His house, and even when you're just chilling outside. Praise Him for all the powerful things He's done, and for how mind-blowingly great He is. Praise Him with a loud trumpet, and with some chill guitar vibes. Praise Him with castanets and dancing, and with the banjo and flute. Praise Him with crashing cymbals and a booming bass drum, and with fiddles and mandolins. Basically, if you're breathing, you should be praising God! Let's gooo!
